epic-samurais.title: Samurai Dynasty
epic-samurais.description: This mod is inspired by the japanes folklore and samurai. It will add new 3D armors and weapons to the game.
epic-samurais.body:
![Epic Samurai's Banner](https://www.dropbox.com/scl/fi/i1uj0agxe82r694kas9pw/Epic-Samurai-s.png?rlkey=ytalttq9tbiyzbg6g4zn28wac&st=qge30jti&dl=1)

![](https://img.shields.io/badge/1.19.2%2C%201.20+-message?style=for-the-badge&label=Minecraft%20Version&labelColor=gray&color=%23ef0954) 
 [![](https://img.shields.io/badge/Forge%20-msg?style=for-the-badge&label=Modloader&color=%23ef0954&cacheSeconds=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.curseforge.com%2Fminecraft%2Fmc-mods%2FCuriosAPI&link=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.curseforge.com%2Fminecraft%2Fmc-mods%2Fgeckolib)](https://files.minecraftforge.net/net/minecraftforge/forge/)  [![](https://img.shields.io/badge/REQUIRED-message?style=for-the-badge&logo=modrinth&label=Azurelib&labelColor=gray&color=%23ef0954)](https://modrinth.com/mod/azurelib)  [![](https://img.shields.io/badge/REQUIRED-message?style=for-the-badge&logo=modrinth&label=CuriosAPI&labelColor=gray&color=%23ef0954)](https://modrinth.com/mod/curios)

---

## 📦 Installation
### Required:
- [Geckolib](https://modrinth.com/mod/geckolib) (before version 0.0.32)
- [Azurelib](https://modrinth.com/mod/azurelib) (from version 0.0.32)
- [Curios](https://modrinth.com/mod/curios)
- [Patchouli - WIP](https://modrinth.com/mod/patchouli)
### Highly recommended
- [JEI](https://modrinth.com/mod/jei)
- [Better Combat](https://modrinth.com/mod/better-combat)
### Compat for
- [Deeper and Darker](https://modrinth.com/mod/deeperdarker)
- [Better Combat](https://modrinth.com/mod/better-combat)
- [Create](https://modrinth.com/mod/create)
- [Ars Nouveau](https://modrinth.com/mod/ars-nouveau)
- [Aquaculture 2](https://github.com/TeamMetallurgy/Aquaculture)
- [Blood Magic](https://modrinth.com/mod/blood-magic)
- [Eldritch End](https://modrinth.com/mod/eldritch-end)

Note: This mod is not compatible with Optifine!

---

## ⭐️ Features
This mod adds new 3D samurai armor sets and weapons to the game!

Try to survive a world full of dangerous japenese creatures, collect their drops and craft unique samurai weapons and armors.
The mobs are not completed yet, they will be soon!

Some of the weapons can be found by exploring the structures of your world.

Note: This mod is still in progress, so it could crash and contain bugs.

---

samurai.title: Grimdark Samurai Pack
samurai.description: This combat pack includes Samurai themed armor, weapons and tools inspired by feudal Japan. Wield katanas, kama, ono, and the yumi bow while customizing your look with menpo armor trims.
samurai.body:
Transform your Minecraft world into feudal Japan with the Grimdark Samurai Pack!

Customize your look with Ninja & Samurai armor while wielding mighty katanas, odachi, kama, ono axes and the yumi bow! This Samurai themed resource pack includes 5 sets of Samurai armor, Ninja-themed armor for leather, and thematically appropriate weapons and tools. This combat resource pack contains primarily tool, weapon & armor textures which makes it easy to pair with a builder's pack of your choosing or to simply enhance your look while building with the vanilla block textures. ![Armor Icons for the Grimdark Samurai Pack by Kalam0n](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/j00w6jx0/images/0be968c52c9be0b7bc1a9b6b2d0c2b9af71854bd.jpeg 'Grimdark Samurai Armor Item Textures') ![Tool & Weapon textures for the Grimdark Samurai Pack by Kalam0n](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/j00w6jx0/images/171cffe6496476bcd8ee342f0cf46576b8d0a262.jpeg 'Grimdark Samurai Tool & Item Textures') The Grimdark Samurai Pack now features custom armor trims for Minecraft 1.20 and up. Customize your samurai armor with menpo masks, trinkets and other accessories using the new armor trim system. Learn more in the video below. This pack also includes damaged item textures, so you always know when your tools are about to break. Optifine is required to support some textures, specifically the Odachi sword variants. These extra large 2-handed katanas can be acquired by renaming your swords at an anvil. For example, renaming a Diamond Sword to include "Odachi" somewhere in the name will change the texture to the Odachi variant. Any naming conventions that do not include a variant identifier will use the standard texture. ![Sword & Odachi textures for the Grimdark Samurai Pack by Kalam0n](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/j00w6jx0/images/2f9cfa9ddd57a82a0fabd272168dc35f00ef1ff6.jpeg 'Grimdark Samurai Sword Textures') Valorite variants are available exclusively in the [Patreon](https://www.patreon.com/kalam0n 'Kalam0ns Patreon Page') VIP version\ Netherite Sword Variants: Muramasa | Norimitsu\ Netherite Axe Variant: Masakari\ Netherite Armor Variant: Valorite
Grimdark FAQ **Q: Can I use this pack as a server resource pack for my server?**\ A: If you are running a small private server, Yes! I only ask that you not re-upload my textures elsewhere or redistribute them. Permission for public servers is granted to all active Grimdark Patrons. **Q: How do I get the variant textures?**\ A: Take the appropriate item to an anvil and rename it using the keyword specified above. **Q: The variant textures aren't working - how do I fix it?**\ A: Variant textures require you to play using Optifine or CITResewn with custom items enabled up to version 1.20.4. Neither currently supports custom item textures in 1.20.6 or 1.21. If variants aren't working, double check your Optifine settings and disable other addons that might be causing conflicts. **Q: When is this pack / texture / feature coming to Bedrock?**\ A: IF it's possible, as soon as I can. Even though Bedrock and Java look similar at surface level they are VERY different. Just because something is created for one doesn't mean it is supported in the other. Similarly, some things are easy to do in Java that are extremely difficult to do in Bedrock. This means some features may never make it to Bedrock. **Q: Can you add X texture / feature?**\ A: Please submit all suggestions and requests via DM on [Patreon](https://www.patreon.com/kalam0n 'Kalam0ns Patreon Page'). **Q: Can I redistribute the Grimdark textures in another pack/mod?**\ A: No.

wizard-samurai-irons-spells-addon.body:
The Wizard Samurai Mod introduces a unique blend of magic and martial prowess, bringing new armor sets, weapons, and a spellbook to enrich your Minecraft experience. The mod is designed for players who enjoy combining strategic combat with magical abilities.

Key Features:
Armor Sets
Wizard Samurai Set
A versatile set designed to balance defensive capabilities with enhanced magical attributes.
Ignis Samurai Set
A fiery set tailored for offensive playstyles, providing bonuses for strength and fire resistance.
Wizard Ignis Samurai Set
The ultimate hybrid, combining the best features of the Wizard and Ignis Samurai sets for players who want unmatched versatility in both magic and combat.
Katanas
Wizard Samurai Katana
A weapon infused with magical energy, perfect for spell-casting warriors.
Ignis Samurai Katana
A blazing katana with fiery effects, ideal for dealing massive damage to foes.
Spellbook
Samurai Spellbook
A powerful tool containing a variety of spells tailored to the Samurai theme. This spellbook allows you to harness unique magical abilities while complementing the new armor sets and katanas.

Gameplay Additions:
Custom Abilities: Each armor set and weapon comes with unique effects and bonuses, enhancing combat and exploration.
Samurai Aesthetic: The mod features stunning textures and designs inspired by traditional Samurai themes, merged with fantasy elements.
Dynamic Playstyles: Whether you prefer a defensive, offensive, or balanced approach, this mod caters to your gameplay style.
Upcoming Features:
Additional Weapons: New magical weapons and tools are planned for future updates.
Expanded Spellbook: More spells with diverse effects, tailored for both combat and utility, are under development.

cherry-samurai-temple.description: Adds a Cherry Samurai Temple with samurai enemies, armor, and katanas
cherry-samurai-temple.body:
## Samurai Temple Mod

Adds a Samurai Temple in Cherry Grove biomes — a multi-layered structure filled with battles, secrets, new loot rewards and a challenging miniboss at the end
![Temple](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/081bca515ee737a29918d7e83035139791689dff.jpeg)
## Temple Features
- Large structure with multiple layers
- Beautifully decorated in traditional Samurai style
- Loot and hidden secrets on each level
- Miniboss fight at the top

## New Mobs
- Samurai: Attacks on sight with a katana, chance to drop the weapon
- Steve Samurai: A stronger miniboss version with a special katana
![Samurai](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/de5e85e5218095a3eb7ce43356d575a62670c6a7.jpeg)

## Weapons
- Katana: Faster than regular swords, repairable with iron ingots
- Cherry Katana: Stronger version that gives a speed boost when held, repairable with amethyst shards
  ![Katanas](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/21fc28f7050cca9947651e3e2624e4271ed59fbd.jpeg)
##   Armor
- Samurai Armor: Scattered throughout the temple, weaker than iron armor, repairable with iron nuggets
  ![Samurai Armor](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8d90572d2b7dd0e4452232417da4f2e77c95c0ee.jpeg)


You are free to include this mod in your modpacks

Made by Leonxkingx and MadeBySanny

![Inside](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d4d81eaa4f299387285acbf2e999be7cc29329e1.jpeg)

power-rangers-samurai.title: Power Rangers Samurai
power-rangers-samurai.description: Become a samurai ranger and use your powers to fight against the forces of evil!
power-rangers-samurai.body:
# [`"Centuries ago in Japan, Nighlok monsters invaded our world, but samurai warriors defeated them with power symbols passed down from parent to child. Today, the evil Nighlok have risen once again and plan to flood the earth. Luckily, a new generation of heroes stand in their way. They are the Power Rangers Samurai."`](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Q9x--4JHOCg) The Power Rangers Samurai are now slashing their way into Minecraft! With this new addonpack powered by [Palladium](https://modrinth.com/mod/threetag-palladium), you can now morph and fight as the world-renowned samurai rangers. *** Required Dependencies: The following mods are required for this mod to work: * Palladium * Gravestone Core * Rhino * KubeJS * GeckoLib * Pehkui * Architectury API * XL Packets * Curios (Forge) * Trinkets (Fabric) *** **Obtainment:**
Spoiler

An essential element is needed in order to craft your samuraizer: Morph X. It's a powerful energy source that connects all rangers to the morphing grid.

As of right now, there are two methods of obtaining it:

#1: Crafting Recipe (Recommended) - The crafting recipe for Morph X can be seen in the media tab for this mod!

#2: Witches and Illagers - A few Witches and Illagers have recently stumbled across an odd substance, and plan to study it to better understand its true power. Anytime you defeat either of the two mob groups, there will be a small chance of them dropping Morph X!

*** **Powers:**
Spoiler

To transform into a samurai ranger, take your designated samuraizer and put it in your curios hands slot (or offhand slot). A menu will the pop up that will let you transform at the press of a button (literally). As a samurai ranger, you have access to several different abilities: 

Physical Buffs: You can run faster, jump higher, have more resistance against attacks, and heal naturally

New Weapons: You gain access to your Spin Sword, a quick weapon with decent damage to boot, along with your ranger's special disk. Use this disk to unlock special abilities!

Elemental Charge: By pressing the designated key while you have your special disk equipped, you will enter a boosted state for about ten seconds. In this state, your Spin Sword will be charged and can do more damage. But be careful! Your symbol power is measured by a bar on the right side of your screen. It regenerates naturally when symbol power is not in use, but if you use all of it up at once, you'll become weakened for a few moments from the overuse of symbol power.

Special Weapon: While using your Elemental Charge, you can switch between your charged sword and your ranger's special weapon on the fly

Energy Blast: While using your Elemental Charge, if you left-click while crouching with your charged sword in hand, you will unleash a strong energy blast to devastate your enemies. However, doing so will deplete a good chunk of your symbol power, so use this wisely!

Special Attack: A move that is unique to each of the rangers. This can be activated when the ranger is either using their special weapon or charged sword.  

*** **Ranger-Specific Abilities:**
Spoiler

Though each ranger has the same base gameplay, their special abilities can completely change the way you approach challenges in the Minecraft world. Experiment with all of them to find out which suits your playstyle.

Jayden: Samurai Red

Playstyle: Glass Cannon

  • Jayden has some of the strongest attacks out of all the rangers, but at the cost of his stronger moves leaving him vulnerable for extended periods of time. You'll have to play smart with your movements to maximize his potential

Weapon: Fire Smasher

  • When this thing hits, it hits HARD! Don't be surprised to see the poor animals going down in one hit from this hefty weapon. However, it has a very slow attack speed, and having it in your hand will slow you down considerably. Good thing the reach on this weapon is INSANE, right?

Special Attack: Cannon Blast Mode

  • Lock your Fire Smasher into cannon blast mode to unleash a final strike that is sure to destroy your enemies. Don't get too hasty, though. This attack takes a while to charge up, and you can't move or jump while it's charging. Once it's finally done, you'll be stuck with debuffs and locked out of your Elemental Charge for a full minute afterwards! Try to use it like an actual final move like they do in the show, alright?  

Mia: Samurai Pink   

Playstyle: Zoner

  • All of Mia's special attacks are either projectiles or AOEs, and they all knock enemies back a fair bit, so you can naturally gain a lot of leverage and control of the space while playing with her. Do be warned that enemies who aren't normally affected by knockback behave no differently with Mia's moves, and so she may struggle with beefier opponents.

Weapon: Sky Fan

  • Right-click to shoot out a small blast of air that does decent damage and knocks the opponent back. Perfect for keep away shenanigans or to give you some space to retreat.

Special Attack: Wave of Air

  • Launch an AOE attack that hits all enemies in the vicinity while pushing them back. As Mia says, "Buzz Off!"

Mike: Samurai Green 

Playstyle: Rushdown

  • Hit 'em hard and hit 'em fast! If you  agree with that philosophy, you and Mike will probably be very good friends! His special moves are great for getting up close and personal with enemies while dealing some quick and easy damage, though he lacks any ranged attacks besides his energy blast move to counterbalance this.

Weapon: Forest Spear

  • A weapon with serviceable damage, longer range than you regular sword, and very fast attack speed for near instant repeated hits. You also get a nice speed boost whenever you're holding this in your hand. What's not to like?

Special Attack: Power Thrust

  • After a short wind-up, you charge yourself at enemies. This is most useful for if you want to cover a lot of ground or attack multiple enemies at once.

Kevin: Samurai Blue   

Playstyle: Support

  • As the only character with an actual support move, Kevin can fill in a very useful nice both in solo and multiplayer play, and is a great ranger for taking care of tanky or incredibly hard hitting enemies.  However, his other special moves are fairly weak projectiles that leave him with below average offensive capabilities outside of the base moveset that all the rangers share.

Weapon: Hydro Bow

  • Right-click to shoot an arrow of pure energy at your opponents for low damage.

Special Attack: Swordfish Disk

  • Use the healing properties of the Swordfish Disk to clear any negative status effects (except Wither) and grant a some positive buffs like healing, resistance, and more! This ability also affects nearby players, making it an exceptional move for supporting groups.

Emily: Samurai Yellow

Playstyle: Jack of All Trades

  • This may be ironic, considering her placement on this list, but Emily is probably the ranger I would recommend most to anyone playing the mod for the first time. She has a pretty diverse moveset that gives her lots of flexibility in combat and makes her arguably the easiest to learn (she's also my favorite ranger in both the show and the mod, tehee). At the same time though, there's isn't really anything Emily does that other rangers don't do better. She's the "master of none" as they say.

Weapon: Earth Slicer

  • Right-click to throw your Earth Slicer for some good damage.

Special Attack: Primate Cyclone

  • Press the designated key with your charged sword in hand to blaze through the terrain and damage anyone in your path. Not only does good damage, but gives you some good movement options as well! 
*** **Credits:** \- [Kelco\_K22](https://www.planetminecraft.com/member/kelco_k22/): For original samurai yellow skin (the others were modified off of their base) \- [LiasDan](https://www.curseforge.com/members/liasdan/projects): For inspiration from Super Sentai Craft \- [lucraft](https://modrinth.com/user/lucraft): For making this mod possible with Palladium

---

### 🪖 Samurai Helmets Pack

This is my **first resource pack**, which adds a collection of custom **samurai-style warrior helmets** inspired by pumpkins.
It works best when used **together with OptiFine** (for CIT support).

---

### ⚔️ Features

* Added **8 Samurai Helmets** — craft them by **renaming a Pumpkin** to:

  ```
  Samurai 1
  Samurai 2
  Samurai 3
  ...
  Samurai 8
  ```
* Each helmet has a unique samurai-inspired design.
* Includes a **prototype Viking helmet**, which will be expanded in future updates.

---

### 🛠️ Future Plans

I plan to add:

* More **helmet variations**
* Additional **custom gear and decorative items**

---

Your feedback means a lot!

🔗 [https://x.com/Black_Bunny_303/status/1787531388344033605](https://x.com/Black_Bunny_303/status/1787531388344033605)

sengoku-legends.description: [1.21.1] Forge your path as a samurai in the Sengoku era of Japan.
sengoku-legends.body:
![Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/39a7e982bc740028f18c5d2b3d874188dedb0b61.jpeg)
# ABOUT
**Step into Sengoku Japan and become the legend your clan needs.**

This modpack is built around the **Sengoku Jidai** mod and expands Minecraft into a survival world inspired by feudal Japan. You will discover Japanese villages, castles, shrines, warriors, yokai, and dangerous lands while fighting to survive and grow stronger.

The pack keeps the vanilla Minecraft feeling, but adds more adventure, atmosphere, challenge, and quality-of-life features. Whether you want to build a peaceful Japanese village, travel as a wandering samurai, or battle mythical creatures, the world gives you a reason to explore.

[![BH](https://www.bisecthosting.com/partners/custom-banners/ca28c1bd-8c0e-4625-bda1-43965a48650c.webp)](https://bisecthosting.cwortex.com/)
# FEATURES
* Japanese-inspired world generation and structures
* Samurai, bandits, clans, and yokai
* Better combat and survival progression
* Thirst, temperature, and more immersive survival
* Storage upgrades, backpacks, waystones, and maps
* Ambient sounds, improved visuals, and useful client features
* A focused vanilla+ experience built around Sengoku Japan
* Fully Optimized with Shader Support

* [Dragon Realm [FORGE]](https://modrinth.com/modpack/dragon-realm-forge) [1.20.1] Dragons, dungeons and bosses.
* [FEAR](https://modrinth.com/modpack/fear) [1.20.1] The Ultimate Horror Modpack.
* [The Better Vanilla](https://modrinth.com/modpack/better-vanilla-fabric) [1.21.X] Vanilla with improved visuals and performance.

Send me your videos on Discord and you will be featured here.

knights.title: knights
knights.description: Adds six new mobs and a few items.
knights.body:
This mod ads 5 new mobs that I had in a different mod in just the structures and now they spawn in the overworld. Mobs: Knights: Will attack you and are armed with mostly iron armor and an iron sword. Archers: Will back from you and shoot arrows ad you. Heavy knights: Will attack you and are armed with gold armor and an iron sword. When they get hurt they can get a boost to fight you. Nobles: Will run away for you and drop some decent items on death including the blaze rod or nobles amulet in their hands. When you're holding a nobles amulet you can trade with them. Peasants: Will run away for you and drop some iron nuggets on death. When you're holding a nobles amulet you can trade with them. Magic knight: Will attack you with slow-shooting magic bullets that stop youre movement, also enchants the knights and archers armor and weapons ![knights](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/856/921/2024-04-30_11.png)

Items : Nobles amulet : This amulet will make none of the knights afraid or hostile against you and allow for trading with peasants, magic knights and nobles if you're holding it. When right clicking when holding the amulet will stop all mobs in the area for a few seconds. This amulet will also make the knights from my other mod https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/flying-castles neutral but doesn't allow trading with the nobles and peasants from that mod.
Trade : Nobles trade : Nobles will mostly trade rare times with you for 1 emerald block. (see image) ![trade](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/391/325/2021-08-28_22.png) Peasants trade : Peasants will mostly trade villager workbenches for 1 iron ingot. (see image) ![trade](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/391/326/2021-08-28_22.png) Magic trade : magic knights will mostly trade brewing items with you for 1 lapis lazuli block. (see image) ![trade](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/856/922/2024-04-30_11.png)

I have a discord server where you can ask questions, talk or put bug reports if you want to do it there https://discord.gg/bBj5vKGFMw. This mod has been made with mcreator

epic-knights-shields-armor-and-weapons.title: Epic Knights: Shields Armor and Weapons
epic-knights-shields-armor-and-weapons.body:
![top_image](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5e67e18f8e368cf1bbdfe006ab8941516ee60cec.webp)
![bh_description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/177f84af906fb27f250597f47f2342cafd66048b.webp)
This mod aims to give Minecraft a more medieval knight-inspired feel. Epic Knights adds historically inspired armor, weapons, heraldry and customization to Minecraft, with an emphasis on making different medieval equipment visually and mechanically distinct. The weapons have unique properties, such as increased attack range, armor-piercing, two-handed, blocking and dismounting capabilities.

Banners can be attached to armor and horse armor in the same way they can be attached to shields. Also there're decorations for armor, such as plumes and crowns, many of which can be dyed in any color.

The mod adds steel as a new material. Steel can be crafted by smelting an iron ingot in a blast furnace.

Configuration files are in config/epicknights folder.

**More historical stuff:**
- [Epic Knights: Addon](https://modrinth.com/mod/epic-knights-addon)
- [Epic Knights: Slavic Armory ](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/epic-knights-slavic-armory)
- [Epic Knights: Antique Legacy ](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/epic-knights-antique-legacy)
- [Epic Knights: Ores and Alloys](https://legacy.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/epic-knights-ores-and-alloys/)
- [Epic Knights: Artillery Addon](https://legacy.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/epic-knights-artillery-addon)
- [Ranged Knights Medieval Boomsticks and Sharpsticks](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/rk-medieval-boomsticks-and-sharpsticks)
- [Epic Knights: Open Helms](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/epic-knights-open-helms)

**IMPORTANT:** Optifine 1.20.x is not supported! Since 7.0 version the mod requires [Architectury](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/architectury-api) and [Cloth Config](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/cloth-config) to be installed.[![Discord Button](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/73fb758cd14024d6ec50ce7d9a33dafcad636ea0.png)](https://discord.gg/R8U8Hpgr75)

death-knights.title: Death Knights (RPG Series)
death-knights.description: ☠️ Embrace darkness and become a Death Knight using Unholy, Blood and Frost magic.
death-knights.body:
## ☠️ Become a deathbringer using blood, unholy and frost magic. [![Modloader](https://img.shields.io/badge/Loader-Fabric-ecebe6?labelColor=263768&style=for-the-badge)](https://legacy.curseforge.com/linkout?remoteUrl=https://fabricmc.net/) [![Connector](https://img.shields.io/badge/Forge-via_Sinytra_Connector-orange?style=for-the-badge)](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/sinytra-connector) [![Discord](https://img.shields.io/discord/790272037578473512.svg?label=&logo=discord&logoColor=ffffff&color=7389D8&labelColor=6A7EC2&style=for-the-badge)](https://discord.gg/lunapixel) ![Environment: Client](https://img.shields.io/badge/CLIENT%20SIDE%20INSTALLATION-REQUIRED-ecebe6?labelColor=263768&style=for-the-badge) ![Environment: Server](https://img.shields.io/badge/SERVER%20SIDE%20INSTALLATION-REQUIRED-ecebe6?labelColor=263768&style=for-the-badge)

--- ## ✨ Discover more of the RPG Series [![Archers](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/755/169/archers_full_275.png)](https://curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/archers) [![Paladins](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/755/170/paladins_full_275.png)](https://curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/paladins-and-priests) [![Wizards](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/755/171/wizards_full_275.png)](https://curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/wizards) [![Rogues](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/899/332/rogues_full_bg_275.png)](https://curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/rogues-and-warriors) [![Jewelry](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/760/387/jewelry_full_275.png)](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/jewelry) **As of Beta 0.3.0, only Frost Death Knight abilities are included in the mod. Blood and Unholy will be coming out soon, as this mod follows the same update cycle as [Prominence II RPG Hasturian Era](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/modpacks/prominence-2-rpg)!** ## 📦 Installation ### Required - [Necronomicon API](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/necronomicon) - [AzureLib Armor](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/azurelib-armor) - [Runes](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/rune-crafting) - [Spell Engine](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/spell-engine) ### Strongly recommended - [Better Combat](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/better-combat-by-daedelus) for proper weapon mechanics ## ✨ Features ## Getting Started ![Getting Started](https://github.com/nvb-uy/cdn/blob/main/desc/death_knights/getting-started.png?raw=true) Create a Spell Binding Table to turn a book into one of the skill books. Add bookshelves around it similar to an enchanting table to bind skills to your skill books, unlocking abilities for your Death Knight specialization. ## Runecarving ![Runecarving](https://github.com/nvb-uy/cdn/blob/main/desc/death_knights/runecarving.png?raw=true) Each Death Knight has their own rune type, being Blood, Unholy or Frost. These runes can be carved inside weapons to transform them into Runic Weaponry. To do so, you can craft a Runecarved Stone, which allows you to fuse those runes into a weapon. ## Death Knight Armors ![Death Knight Armors](https://github.com/nvb-uy/cdn/blob/main/desc/death_knights/Armors.png?raw=true) Create the Death's Call armor set and upgrade it to one of the three variants: Plaguebringer for Unholy, Frozen Champion for Frost, or Crimson Guard for Blood. ## 🤝 Integrations - ✅ Better Combat - ✅ Jewelry - Death Knight Jewelry - 🏗️ Simply Swords - Runic Weapon Compatibility ## 🏗️ Roadmap - Blood Death Knight Abilities (v0.5.0) ## 📚 Credits - [Mim1q](https://www.curseforge.com/members/mim1q/projects) for making the textures & models of most items. - **Inkgum** for making the models and textures of the spec-specific armor sets. - [Daedelus](https://www.curseforge.com/members/daedelus_dev/projects) for providing the Blood Rune texture, and making Spell Engine & RPG Series, inspiring this mod. - [Blizzard for making the Warcraft series that created the Death Knights](https://wowpedia.fandom.com/wiki/Death_knight), which is what this mod is about. - [Roost_er](https://www.curseforge.com/members/cleannrooster/projects) for inspiring some of the skill casting style, from their mod [Spellblades and Such](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/spellblade-next).

death-knights-balacing-datapack-for-prom.title: Death Knights - Balacing Datapack for Prominence II: RPG
death-knights-balacing-datapack-for-prom.description: This Datapack will be used to buff Unholy Death knight, but it will also give the ability to change the values of all other death knights spells if need be.
death-knights-balacing-datapack-for-prom.body:
This Datapack will be used to buff Unholy Death knight, but it will also give the ability to change the values of all other Death Knights spells 
Note that increasing Plagues stacks is highly recommended, i suggest somewhere between 6-10 per plague, you do this in the death knights plague config file

Unholy:
Festering Strike
- changed physical damage coefficient from 0.8 to 2.4 and the unholy coefficient from 1.2 to 2.6
- increased range from 3.5 to 5
- lowered cooldown duration from 4 to 2.5
- made festering wound's duration 1 to 10

Lesser Festering Strike
- change spell power coefficient from 1.0 to 2 for unholy and from 0.8 to 2 for melee
- lowered cooldown from 6 to 3
- increased range from 3.5 to 5

Death Coil
- increased projectile velocity from 1.2 to 2
- increased spell power coefficient from 1.2 to 4
- lowered cooldown from 6 to 5

Epidemic
- changed spell power coefficient of the impact from 0.0 to 2

Death Grip
- lowered cooldown from 8 to 6

epic-knights-antique-legacy.title: Epic Knights: Antique Legacy
epic-knights-antique-legacy.description: Adds antique stuff as an addition to Epic Knights mod
epic-knights-antique-legacy.body:
Epic Knights: Antique legacy addon delves into the forgotten battlefields of history, bringing a treasure trove of antique weaponry and armor to your gameplay experience. It adds a huge variety of armor (71 pieces), 5 new shields, 20 new weapons and 26 decorations.
The addon requires [Epic Knights](https://www.modrinth.com/mod/epic-knights-shields-armor-and-weapons) mod with all its dependencies to be installed.
Tin is not generated in the world yet. However, you can install any mod that adds tin to be able to melt it together with copper.
![armor](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/xODj7fc3/images/7b034282cde6838d011a1d9f9fe2fbad69c1fe02.png)

knights-and-castles.title: Knights And Castles
knights-and-castles.description: This Minecraft mod adds medieval guards, undead knights, and regular knights to the game, along with new weapons like lances and katanas. It also introduces the mythical phoenix, enhancing the medieval fantasy experience.
knights-and-castles.body: [![](https://img.shields.io/modrinth/game-versions/knights-and-castles?logo=modrinth&color=242629&labelColor=00AF5C&logoColor=white)](https://modrinth.com/mod/knights-and-castles) [![](https://img.shields.io/modrinth/dt/knights-and-castles?logo=modrinth&label=&style=flat&color=242629&labelColor=00AF5C&logoColor=white)](https://modrinth.com/mod/knights-and-castles) [![CF](https://cf.way2muchnoise.eu/versions/1038253_all.svg)](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/knights-and-castles) [![CF](https://cf.way2muchnoise.eu/full_1038253.svg)](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/knights-and-castles) # Knights and Castles ### (1.0.6+) Please Recreate Your Worlds to use the New Biome and Mobs!!! ### Description The Knights and Castles Mod enriches your Minecraft experience by introducing a variety of medieval-themed entities and items. This mod includes: * **Medieval Guards:** Protect your villages from threats with these new NPCs. * **Undead Knights:** Encounter and battle these fearsome foes during the night. * **Noble Knights:** Ally with these brave warriors for extra protection. * **New Weapons:** Equip yourself with lances for jousting and katanas for swift combat. * **Phoenix:** Discover or summon the mythical phoenix, adding a touch of fantasy to your world. * **And Much More!** ## We Got Featured in a Mod Showcase! ### Purpose The purpose of this mod is to enhance the medieval and fantasy aspects of Minecraft, offering new challenges and allies, as well as a range of unique weapons and mythical creatures. ### Why Should You Use This? * **Immersive Experience:** Dive into a richly detailed medieval world with new characters and items. * **Enhanced Combat:** Enjoy the strategic depth provided by new weapons and enemy types. * **Fantasy Elements:** Encounter the legendary phoenix, adding excitement and lore to your adventures. * **Village Protection:** Ensure your villages are safe with the help of medieval guards and noble knights. Elevate your Minecraft gameplay with the Knights and Castles Mod for an exciting blend of history and fantasy!

ranged-knights-medieval-boomsticks-and-s.title: Ranged Knights Medieval Boomsticks and Sharpsticks
ranged-knights-medieval-boomsticks-and-s.description: Medieval Era ranged and melee weapons, guns, and more!
ranged-knights-medieval-boomsticks-and-s.body:
![thumbnail](https://i.imgur.com/0i4Pyyz.png)
Ranged Knights Medieval Boomsticks and Sharpsticks! Another weapon addon mod for Epic Knights with a focus on ranged armaments and munitions. This mod will bring you several 3D and animated firearms, ranged weapons, and melee weapons into your game. 

Current contents of the mod:

3 Ores for iron, will be used for alloying and casting new materials later.

2 Throwing rocks, big one and little one.

3 Maces, for hard melee power.

4 Throwing weapons capable of melee. With a dyable javelin!

1 Arbalest heavy crossbow with custom animation

2 Historical firearms used in medieval eras. The Arquebus and Hand-gonne

1 Legendary firearm. The spiked hand-gonne that fires 3 bullets at once!

Several intermediate crafting items used for enhanced recipes. (some is current placeholders for future content and some items are currently not craftable as of the moment)

Most of these items are highly configurable in files. You will be able to tweak cooldown times, reload times, armor penetration, damage, and more!

Mod requires Geckolib for functional animations.

Fabric version coming soon!

If you wish to support my content creation and mod development, please consider making a donation through PayPal!

Special thanks to the following contributors for making this possible: SangreBK, artisianBK, Magistu, StaxiHD



FAQ:

Fabric version? - Currently work in progress.

Will you backport to versions like 1.19? - Will only be using 1.20.1 and upwards. Backporting requires alot of extra time and work due to code changes. This could change however.

Is the mod compatible with recruits mod? - Most weapons will NOT be usable with recruits mod due to how these weapons function, there is no plan to add compatibility.

Where can I report bugs and suggest features? - You may submit bug reports and suggestions in the Epic Knights Addons discord server.

Where are the modded armors from in screenshots? - They are from the Epic Knights mod and other addons!

tiny-skeletons.title: Tiny Skeletons
tiny-skeletons.description: Teeny, tiny skeletons, send shivers down your spine...
tiny-skeletons.body:
Tiny Skeletons brings baby skeletons to Minecraft at last! 💀 If baby zombies exist, why not skeletons too? Normal skeletons, strays, bogged, parched, and even wither skeletons can now spawn as tiny variants, each with their own unique behaviors, attacks, and rewards.

Cute? Sometimes. Harmless? Absolutely not. ✨

  • 💀 Natural Spawning: Baby skeleton variants spawn naturally with a 5% chance, just like baby zombies.
  • 🏹 Baby Skeletons: Fight with bows at range, then quickly switch to melee combat with a wooden sword when you get too close.
  • ❄️ Baby Strays: Throw icy snowballs mixed with pebbles that deal a small amount of damage and knock targets back. They may even drop blue ice when defeated.
  • 🍄 Baby Bogged: Toss mushrooms at their enemies from a distance, dealing light damage while providing unique mushroom themed drops.
  • 🏜️ Baby Parched: Throw chunks of sand at nearby targets and can provide a handy source of sand.
  • 🖤 Baby Wither Skeletons: Surprisingly timid creatures that flee when approached, terrified you might steal the wither skeleton skull they always carry. Defeat one for a guaranteed skull drop, or trade it a wither rose instead.
  • 🎁 Unique Rewards: Several baby skeleton variants offer special drops and alternate ways to obtain useful resources.

⏩ INSTALLATION REQUIRED ON CLIENT & REQUIRED ON SERVER

⏩ REQUIRES PUZZLES LIB TO BE INSTALLED (FABRIC & NEOFORGE)

⏩ REQUIRES FABRIC API TO BE INSTALLED (FABRIC)

⏩ REQUIRES FORGE CONFIG API PORT TO BE INSTALLED (FABRIC)

If available for a mod, configuration is possible directly from in-game using the mod menu (requires Mod Menu by Prospector to be installed on Fabric).

For manual configuration using an external text editor all files are found at .minecraft/config, named as MOD_ID-client.toml, MOD_ID-common.toml, or MOD_ID-server.toml, depending on the type of config. Not all types might exist for a mod, if any at all.

🌟 Thanks to Daveyx0 for inspiring the baby skeleton's combat behavior with the skeleton warrior from their Primitive Mobs mod.

🌟 Thanks to Globox_Z for some of the code for rendering items on the back of baby skeletons from their BackSlot mod.

🌟 Thanks to Furgle for inspiring baby wither skeletons carrying skulls from their Baby Mobs mod.

skeleton-horse-spawn.title: Skeleton Horse Spawn
skeleton-horse-spawn.description: ☠🐴 Allows skeleton horses to spawn naturally with a skeleton riding it and other tweaks.
skeleton-horse-spawn.body:
Skeleton Horse Spawn is a minimalistic configurable mod which allows skeleton horses to spawn naturally with a skeleton riding it. Whenever a skeleton spawns, it has a chance to be spawned as a rider. You can configure it to only spawn on the surface and if it should burn in daylight.

You may also be interested in Giant Spawn or Zombie Horse Spawn.








   All available config options:

Show Spoiler

chanceSurfaceSkeletonHasHorse  default 0.05, min 0, max 1.0
The chance a skeleton that has spawned on the surface is riding a horse.

shouldBurnSkeletonHorsesInDaylight  default true
If enabled, burns skeleton horses when daylight shines upon them.

onlySpawnSkeletonHorsesOnSurface  default true
If enabled, a skeleton horse with rider will only spawn on the surface.

skeletonHorsesCanDespawn  default true
If enabled, skeleton horses spawned by the mod despawn like other monsters when no player is near. A horse with a saddle, armor, an owner, a name tag or a lead stays.

dimensionsToSpawnIn  default ""
Dimensions in which skeletons can spawn riding a skeleton horse, separated by a comma. Leave empty for every dimension. For example: 'minecraft:overworld'.

biomesToSpawnIn  default ""
Biomes in which skeletons can spawn riding a skeleton horse, separated by a comma. Biome tags work too, starting with a '#'. Leave empty for every biome. For example: 'minecraft:plains,#minecraft:is_savanna'.




You may freely use this mod in any modpack, as long as the download remains hosted within the CurseForge or Modrinth ecosystem.

Serilum.com contains an overview and more information on all mods available.

For issues, ideas, suggestions or anything else there is the Github repo. Thanks!

mutant-skeleton-armor-tweaks.title: Mutant Skeleton Armor Tweaks
mutant-skeleton-armor-tweaks.description: Mutant Skeleton Chestplate now compatible with crossbows!
mutant-skeleton-armor-tweaks.body:
# Mutant Skeleton Armor Tweaks

**Mutant Skeleton Armor Tweaks (MSAT)** is an add-on that aims to customize and balance the effects from the Mutant Skeleton armor set from Fuzs' Mutant Monsters mod.

---

## Features

### In game config
- Toggle each armor piece's default effect in the in game config (or the config file).
- Config is synced from servers to clients upon joining.
- Only OPed players can modify the mod's settings in game. Singleplayer worlds are not affected by this.

### Crossbow compatibility
- A config toggle allows the Mutant Skeleton Chestplate to buff crossbow draw speed. (Also buffs other weapons with the #c:ranged_weapons tag)

### Custom tooltips
- Only available when **[Custom Tooltip API](https://modrinth.com/mod/custom-tooltip-api)** is installed.
  - Effect descriptions are dynamically displayed (when the effects are active in the config) inside each armor piece's tooltip.
  - These descriptions are shown as a potion effect (legs, boots) or a line displayed when the player presses the corresponding keybind (`Shift` by default).

---

## Compatibility

* **Eldritch End:** Mutant Skeleton Skull compatible with Eldritch End's infusions.

wither-skeleton-tweaks.title: Wither Skeleton Tweaks
wither-skeleton-tweaks.description: QoL features for dealing with Wither Skeletons
wither-skeleton-tweaks.body:
# About

Wither Skeleton Tweaks makes farming and searching for wither skeletons a much easier task. Vanilla's method of farming skulls is frustrating at
best, and I believe I can do better.

## Wither Skull Fragments

Any wither skeleton that does not drop a Wither Skeleton Skull will drop a Wither Skull Fragment.

![](https://i.imgur.com/Dp9M5Ka.png)

## Skeleton Conversion

Any skeleton that spawns in the nether will be converted to a Wither Skeleton. They will retain their original weapons, so converted Skeletons will
have bows.

![](https://i.imgur.com/HRVJ0xG.png)

## Drop Cleanup

Damaged Stone Swords and Bows are removed from the drop tables of all skeleton-based creatures, including Wither Skeletons, Skeletons, and Strays.

## Immolation Blade

Wither Skeleton Tweaks also adds the Immolation Blade, a sword which causes instant death and beheading for all skeleton-based creatures.

![](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/255902/description_a0f8025c-0586-41f6-ae85-04795db6f488.webp)

# Support Me

undead-nights.title: Undead Nights - Zombie Horde Nights / Hordes
undead-nights.description: This Mod adds Horde Nights to the game, with hordes of Zombies hunting the player in a Zombie Apocalypse.
undead-nights.body:
[![CurseForge Downloads](https://img.shields.io/curseforge/dt/1166914?logo=curseforge&logoColor=black&label=&labelColor=orange&color=242424)](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/undead-nights) [![Modrinth Downloads](https://img.shields.io/modrinth/dt/undead-nights?style=flat&logo=modrinth&logoColor=black&label=&labelColor=18ED49&color=242424)](https://modrinth.com/mod/undead-nights) [![Supported Versions](https://cf.way2muchnoise.eu/versions/1166914(4F21AC).svg)](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/undead-nights) [![Discord](https://img.shields.io/discord/1388544059114786907?style=flat&logo=discord&logoColor=white&label=&labelColor=blue)](https://discord.gg/rSVp3nCpPx) [![Static Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/Ko--fi-75D5E3?logo=ko-fi)](https://ko-fi.com/D1D71EVQVC)

This mod adds Horde Nights to Minecraft.

Please report any problems you find under: [issues](https://github.com/MC-Mods-Pete/UndeadNights/issues)

### Configuration

How to configure the UndeadNights Mod

**IMPORTANT:**
With version 2.0.0 and the addition of a difficulty system the whole config system went through some significant changes. Please make sure to backup your old setup before updating and carefully read the Wiki (especially the part about the difficulty config).

**Note:** if you are using horde config variant 2 you need to update you horde config when switching to mod version 1.2.0!

News
_Version 2.0.0_

- new difficulty system added
- cave spawning added (needs to be enabled in the config)
- horde spawn system reworked (spawning is now asynchronus, to minimize impact on tps)
- compatibilty to comforts mod (sleeping bags) added
- config option to extend horde nights to full horde days added
- lure horde effect now searches asynchronous for horde mobs, to reduce impact on tps
- strong lure horde effect added (will always spawn a horde, needs to be crafted, for multiplayer fun)
- config option to set the number of players that get a horde per horde event added
- config option to ignore gamerule doMobSpawning added
- possibility to add custom target entities to hordeMobConfig added



<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

_Version 1.3.0_
- the way horde mobs climb on each other was improved
- vanilla zombies in hordes can be configured to float, break blocks and not burn in the sun
- horde zombies can now break all blocks (incl. obsidian), set block breaking tier to 4
- config option to increase horde mob movement speed on water added 
- config option to enable spawn proving with lights (e.g. with torches) added (note: sky light is ignored)
- config option for a grace period before first horde night added
- config option for max hordes per horde night (set to 0 for no limit) added
- config option for the possibility of a random horde on non horde nights added
- config option to disable "a horde has spawned" message and the horde sound
- new "horde lure" effect added (with the chance that the player gets this effect, when killing horde mobs)
- the horde lure effect can be configured to spawn a horde, when they player gets it
- all three types of horde zombies added by this mod will now spawn naturally at night (can be disabled)

_Version 1.2.0 changes_
- horde config variant 2 can now have several hordes
- horde zombies can break blocks (disabled per default)
  3 block breaking tiers:
  1 - glass and dirt
  2 - stone
  3 - iron bars and doors
- demolition zombies will now throw the tnt
- updated commands to enable/disable block breaking, set default horde...

</details>




- _**Forge**_ - The config file is stored per world:\
  _minecraft/saves/[NAME_OF_YOUR_WORLD]/serverconfig/undeadnights-server.toml_
- _**NeoForge**_ - The config file is stored per Minecraft installation / instance:\
  _minecraft/config/undeadnights-server.toml_
- _**Fabric**_ - The config file is stored per Minecraft installation / instance:\
  _minecraft/config/undeadnights.json5_\
  exclusive on Fabric in singleplayer: you can install the mod "mod menu" and access the config screen

![Undead](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/895415d23f9d7392797ab89363d53330c65d139f_0.webp)

- **Horde Zombies**
  - are faster, deal more damage and have more health
  - have a large tracking range, to hunt down the player
  - will not burn in the sun and will not despawn
  - will climb on top of each other to reach the Player
  - will "swim" (float) on the water and not sink
  - will not turn to drowned
  
- The Frequency of Horde Nights can be configured
- The Horde size can be configured (incl. a total spawn cap) 

**Spezial Horde zombies**:
- Demolition Zombies - carry TNT, that they will try to ignite when close to the player

the-undead-revamped.body:
THE UNDEAD REVAMPED — Create your game server

 

I SWEAR IF I SAW ANYONE COMMENT ABT MOBS SPAWNING IN LIT PLACES, WHEN THEY ARE CAUSED BY MODS COMPATIBILITY REASONS, OR OLDER VERSIONS I WILL BE GIVING OUT FREE COMMENTS DELETION. (IF YOU BELIEVE YOUR REASONS ARE GENUINE PLEASE CONTACT ME THROUGH DISCORD)

 

This mod adds new types of Undead (currently 29) most of them being zombies. This mod makes Minecraft very challenging, and the new mobs give you the choice to escape instead of fighting.

 

 

 

NOW AVAILABLE FOR  1.20.1/1.19.2/ 1.18.2

This mod adds strong and challenging undead mobs. This mod makes Minecraft very challenging, and the new mobs give you the choice to escape instead of fighting. They are pretty scary too, but fear not! All these zombies have their 

own weaknesses which you can exploit and defeat them with ease! (If you want to include this mod into your modpack just add the mod's link to your page and that's fine) All of these mobs have many different skills like ramming,

exploding, and much more.

GAMEPLAY

 

ZOMBIES ARE EVERYWHERE...

RIP AND TEAR

UNTIL IT'S DONE.

 

THIS MOD REQUIRES GECKOLIB

NOTE: Playing with shaders may cause animations to often bugged out, and it’s ugly trust me. ( Try turning off entity shadows if you still insist on using the shaders)
You will see mobs posing like this chasing you
 

 

 

ALL MODPACK MAKERS AND PLAYERS MUST READ

(Combine it with slime and you will get a Molotov called Napalm sack) The acid sack can also be crafted into a bowl in which you can put egg or snow gaining Debuff resistance which removes certain bad effects inflicted on your body. For a quick drink you can right click the bowl on water sources to get a tea. (Cauldron also works)

undead-unleashed.title: Undead Unleashed - Continued
undead-unleashed.description: Adds new formidable fantasy-like enemies with unique abilities.
undead-unleashed.body:
![title](https://i.ibb.co/fhZxpWN/title-text.png)

**Undead Unleashed** is a mod aiming to expand the variety of enemy encounters, giving Minecraft a dark/medieval fantasy style while keeping the familiar aesthetic.

Just underwent a massive rework and got ported to 1.21.1! Note that some of older content may not be present anymore and it's intentional.

Currently supported Minecraft versions: **Neoforge 1.21.1, Forge 1.20.1**
 
Also on [CurseForge](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/undead-unleashed).

If you are creating a modpack and want to modify spawn weights of each mob, use the [Spawn Weight Config](https://modrinth.com/datapack/undead-unleashed-spawn-weight-config) datapack!


**Content:**


<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

**Creatures:**
- Dreadknight

![dreadknight](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1788/670/2026-07-12_13-24-00-png.png)

Durable warriors roaming the overworld. Facing one can end poorly if you are unprepared - they can both aggressively hack away at their foes as well as act defensively using their shield

- Wraith

![wraith](https://i.ibb.co/hxmj7hQw/2026-07-05-23-38-09.png)

Dark malevolent undead inhabiting underground caverns. They vanish after getting attacked and then ambush the target. When exposed to sunlight, they burn.

- Flamebreather

![flamebreather](https://i.ibb.co/nNqqWzJD/2026-07-06-00-04-43.png)

Large half-flying beasts native to the Nether, most notably the Wastes, Crimson Forests and Basalt Deltas. As their name suggests they can spew out flames and turn you to ash. They are very dangerous especially near overhangs so be careful not to let them push you off to lava!
A natural enemy for Piglins.

**Other:**
Plate Armor - made out of Heavy Plating dropped by Dreadknights, each piece gives you additional chance to block arrows up to a 50% when wearing a full set. Great armor if you want to survive a rain of arrows or be slightly less annoyed by Skeletons or Pillagers!

Knight Sword - a fancy sword used by Dreadknights, has a chance to be dropped from them. Makes mobs caught in the sweeping range take more damage than from a normal sword, a decent choice against crowds (only on 1.21.1+, sweeping damage ratio attribute is unavailable on 1.20.1). Can be repaired using Heavy Plating

Demon Stew - A soup made of Nether Wart, Brown Mushrooms, Carrots and Demon Horns. Gives you Fire Breath for a few seconds, much like a Flamebreather!

zoniex.title: Zombie Nightmare Expansions - Undead Horror Monsters
zoniex.description: Adds various creepy undead entities with unique mechanics and intricate designs
zoniex.body:
![ZoNiEx](https://i.imgur.com/TFjyNcP.png)

**Welcome to Zombie Nightmare Expansions, a new horror mod centred on adding new undead monsters with unique nightmarish mechanics.**


Discord server https://discord.gg/arphex



These mobs appear rarely in any overworld biomes and their spawn rates can be configured individually (including disabling specific mobs if required). All modpack inclusions welcome. More mobs planned in future!



Current mobs:



DISEMBOWELER

![Disemboweler mob](https://i.imgur.com/BKHrrit.png)

Large, monstrous zombie with entrails hanging out, seeking blood and vengeance. Lumbers around looking for players and cows to consume, with attacks packing a heavy punch. Drops "corrupted heart" items on death.



TORMENTED STEVE

![Tormented Steve mob](https://i.imgur.com/L2OhFb9.png)

A hideous monstrosity disguising itself as a regular player (eight player skin variants). When stationary, it resembles the normal skin, but as soon as it moves, the true nightmarish form comes out. Sometimes found hanging from ceilings ready to drop on your head. A very strong and vicious opponent, dropping enchanted golden apples on death. 



BLOOD EAGLE

![Blood Eagle mob](https://i.imgur.com/pEh49ek.png)

A huge demon/dragon-like zombie with appendages made entirely from stretched out flesh, and sporting a set of razor-sharp teeth. Capable of both flying and walking, sometimes attacking from the air with spit projectiles or from the ground with melee - Eats pigs. Very strong, plus tameable and rideable (tamed with 10 corrupted hearts, configurable to disable taming).


BRUTALISER

![Brutaliser mob](https://i.imgur.com/5eabGBT.png)

MINIBOSS. A huge, strong zombie that can smash the ground to create block shockwaves dealing devastating damage and knockback on impact. You can jump over shockwaves or evade them - whenever you move close to attack, be sure to evade quickly before it gets the chance to strike! Attacks sheep and drops a "Deathly Onyx" on death, used for crafting a special staff item that lets you repulse nearby undead mobs (right click hold) and even summon crawling minions (ground left click ability, charges up to 5 stored summons by killing undead while it is in your inventory).


SKIN CRAWLER

![Skin Crawler mob](https://i.imgur.com/JRNXEEY.png)

The weakest enemy in the mod, but more relentless than any other. Capable of camouflaging itself by changing colour to match the blocks around it, and breaking through stone, deepslate, tuff, granite, diorite, andesite, and netherrack to get to you (this can be disabled in config). Moreover, it can climb walls and crawl through tight spaces, making it hard to avoid fully. Also attacks chickens.


SPINE WRENCHER

![Spine Wrencher mob](http://i.imgur.com/9Cmg8Ue.png)

A tall, thin entity with tendril-like arms and a related appearance to the blood eagle, perhaps coming from a similar origin. This entity has to be close to spot you, unless you look directly at it. If you do so, then it will notice and come running towards your location. Given how thin it is, it has become fragile, so if you block its attacks with a shield, it will take damage whenever it tries to attack, providing a strong way of countering it. It is more than two blocks tall, but can crouch down to get through smaller gaps. Drops “Distorted Vertebrae” on death, used for crafting a powerful whip item.


Staff of the Undead crafting recipe includes both the Deathly Onyx and two Deathly Heart items, along with some vanilla components:

![Staff Recipe](https://i.imgur.com/PPZwie6.png)

Whiplasher - crafting recipe includes a netherite ingot surrounded by eight "distorted vertebrae" dropped by Spine Wrencher mobs.
![Whip Recipe](https://i.imgur.com/DNIVxed.png)

the-lunar-undead.title: The Lunar Undead [TLU]
the-lunar-undead.description: The Lunar Undead or TLU for short, is a horror mod in which your goal is to become the Lunar King.
the-lunar-undead.body:
[Discord Server](https://discord.gg/sqJW2Xu8Mk)

The Lunar Undead or TLU for short, is a horror mod in which your goal is to become the Lunar King.



This mod is made as a submission for MCreative's Discord Modjam.







Main Features:



- Lunar Undead mobs:

Most Undead mobs in-game have a 4% chance of spawning as a Lunar-Undead mob. Lunar Undead mobs are immune to fire and have resistance and strength buffs. They also move around faster and get stronger when it is a full moon night. Undead mobs that can spawn as Lunar-Undead: Zombies, Skeletons (All variants), Wither Skeletons, Phantoms, Zombie Piglins, and Zoglins. Killing a Lunar-Undead mob will drop Lunar Essence which is used for various recipes.







- The Lunar Wraith and Lunar Peak:

Lunar Wraiths are mysterious, and will always spawn as a lunar-undead mob. Most of the time, they'd look translucent but if you catch them at the right time, they would become opaque and have a glowing effect. The time that Lunar Wraiths become opaque and glow is called a Lunar Peak, which is the Time in which it is midnight while it is a Full Moon. Lunar Wraiths are rare to find, so you don't have to worry about them too much. Lunar Invasions also exist, which have a 1% chance of occurring at the beginning of a full moon night. It makes a lot of undead mobs spawn as lunar undead (50% by default), makes players unable to sleep, and Lunar Undead mobs get even stronger and faster, like Lunar Peak.







- The Mysterious Being-M:

Using the Lunar Essence gathered by killed lunar undead mobs, you could make Lunar Magma Blocks in a T-shaped golem pattern to summon a boss mob, which is called Being-M. You can only summon Being-M at a Lunar Peak and you can fight it up until right before Sunrise before it disappears while laughing. Being-M drops an item called "Lunar Energy Core", which is used to make Lunar Ingot.





- Lunar King's Armor and Weapons:

Using the Lunar Ingot mentioned before, you can craft Lunar King's armor, Lunar King's Sword, and Lunar King's Dagger. The Lunar King's Dagger is used in the process of turning yourself into an Undead Player. You can use the dagger to inflict yourself with Lunar Curse, which if you get killed by an undead mob, you'd turn into an undead player which gives night vision, but makes you burn in Sunlight if not wearing any helmet cover. Burning to death as an Undead player will return you back to a normal player.





- Awakening as a Lunar King:

As an undead player, you'd climb to the sky, with armor fit for a king in a Lunar Peak will turn you into a Lunar King. Awakening as a Lunar King will damage worn armor into having only 1 durability per piece of armor. As a Lunar King, you'd gain the same Lunar Powers as all other Lunar Undead mobs, but like Lunar Wraiths and Being-M, you'd also have a small chance of teleporting behind whoever attacked you.





- Items and Anti-Lunar Potions:

These are all the ingredient and potion items in-game. There's also Anti-Lunar Potion. To craft that potion, you have to get Silvery Iron Ingot with Awkward Potion. The Anti-Lunar Potion can disable the resistance and strength buffs of Lunar-Undead mobs if applied to them, though it won't work on Lunar Kings and Being-M. You'd have to make a stronger version of the potion (Anti-Lunar II) in order to affect Lunar Kings and Being-M. The stronger version of the Anti-Lunar Potion can also inflict damage to lower-level Lunar Undead mobs, like zombies (must be a lunar undead), lunar wraiths, etc. 





Questions & Answers:


Q1) Does this support versions 1.16.5 / 1.12.2 / 1.18.2 / 1.19.2?

A1) No, it doesn't.



Q2) When is the Fabric version?

A2) I'm sorry little one... (translation: no.)



Q3) Can I use it in a modpack?

A3) Sure, why not? It's free advertising.



Q4) Can I upload a let's play video on this mod?

A4) Sure, why not? It's free advertising. (2.0)



Q5) Where can I report bugs?

A5) Either leave it in the comments section or contact me on Discord.



Q6) Will there be updates?

A6) Probably there will be updates, but I won't promise anything.



Q7) What is the best strategy for dealing with Lunar Undead mobs?

A7) Avoid them until you get at least full iron gear, then you can start fighting them.



Q8) What game mode should I play first?

A8) I recommend playing survival mode for the best experience.



Q9) How do I craft XX item/block?

A9) Either discover them yourself or use mods like JEI.



Q10) Where is ALIT: Magitech?!

A10) ALIT: Magitech will come someday, just wait for now since it will be many times larger than ALIT: Sunlight Zombie. Join the Discord server for more information (the invite link can be found at the start of the mod description)



Q11) How are you?

A11)  Bread 👍

Water, food, and the infected are all vectors for the plague. Adapt fast, scavenge smarter, and stay one step ahead of the infection… or become part of it. This isn't just survival. **It's survival reimagined.** --- ## 💥 Features - 🧪 **Zombie Infection System** — Water, food, and zombies are all vectors. Stay clean, or become one of them. Configure symptom onset, infection duration, mutation severity, and transmission. - 🩸 **Zombie Guts Camouflage** — Smear yourself in zombie remains to become invisible to the horde… until it rains and washes it away. - 🌧️ **Environmental Reactions** — Rain extinguishes campfires, strips camouflage, and fills cauldrons. tdw-ur.body:
![The Dead Wastelands Undead Rising](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4cb0447fa400ca70d06126e12bc548b26d87b10a.png) A world infested with zombies is pretty dangerous, don't you agree? Old Minecraft features are gone, now you have stamina, body temperature and a new HP system. I advise you to take care of the base right after spawn, because a crowd of zombies walks at night. It is best to make bunkers, because various natural phenomena are happening now, like tornadoes. Remember how I said that it is better not to let zombies close to you? Well, they can infect you. When hit by a zombie, an "infection" effect appears, which has several phases. I advise you to eat a golden apple after the bite.
With each new day, zombies become stronger and more dangerous. It is better to keep a gun with you, because their blow becomes more painful, and HP - more.
 
                                                                                                                  
![Features of our assembly:](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8453f17e15d97623c5693632f08c1856ddf88898.png)


•The assembly has a new HP, endurance and temperature system. Take care of your head and body, because these are important parts of the body!

•In addition to ordinary zombies, the assembly now has mutants, mutants - stronger zombies, capable of lifting you up with one blow.

•Various natural phenomena have been added: tornadoes, sandstorms and others.
And also added various mods for a better experience.
![Mods](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/94cd6c044d3680e0129b18a008bc72fd186dc181.png)

 🔫New weapons, both firearms and melee, have been added by the mods "[TaCZ] Timeless and Classic Zero" and "Zombie Survival Kit".

beundead.title: Be Undead
beundead.description: If you die, you are a zombie.
beundead.body:
# If you die, you will turn into a zombie.

Being a zombie has many disadvantages, but don't worry, you can be turned back by using a weakness potion and a golden apple.

I challenge you to play through the game while being a zombie.

![You can play in your modified skin as a Zombie](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/adc57b039e690a924c90a414b8d2bbeffbec3f39.png)
![It has gameplay implications](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/912f4afe5ef8b3e3bec2e57cc33642a45dc8c9c5.png)


## Features

You can play as:
-Zombie
-Drowned (when you die under water)
-Husk (when you die on sand)

Zombies only have one inventory slot with the armor and offhand slots, but you can right-click a chest to get access to the rest of the hotbar. (This can be modified in the config)

They can only gain experience through killing.
If not wearing a helmet or being a husk, zombies will burn in sunlight.
Drowns can swim and breath under water.
For zombies, healing/harming potions are inverted and the smite enchantment does additional damage.

Pick and choose your favorites from our [website](https://gm4.co), or wherever you get datapacks.
