undead-horse-variants.title: Undead Horse Variants
undead-horse-variants.description: All new variants for the skeleton horses and zombie horses! Fully implemented with custom textures and gameplay.
undead-horse-variants.body:
This mod/datapack adds in five new skeleton & zombie horse variants based off of their humanoid counterparts!

All of these new variants — as well as the previously unused zombie horses — have been implemented into the game via vanilla-flavored mechanics reminiscent of how skeleton horses work.

**New Undead Horses:**
- Stray Horse
- Bogged Horse
- Wither Skeleton Horse
- Drowned Horse
- Husk Horse

**If you enjoy this mod/datapack, consider trying out [Saddles Squared](https://modrinth.com/project/eB9bMeol) as well!** The latest version has built-in compatabilty with Undead Horse Variants.

<details>
<summary>Installing / Uninstalling</summary>

**NOTE: [Entity Texture Features](https://modrinth.com/project/BVzZfTc1) and [Entity Model Features](https://modrinth.com/project/4I1XuqiY) are both required for this datapack/mod to function correctly.**

---

### Install As Mod

**Either...**
1. Download the correct version and drop the JAR file into your mods folder, **OR-**
2. Install the mod via Modrinth.

---

### Install As Datapack

1. Download the correct version and place the main ZIP file into your world's datapacks folder.
2. Place the resources ZIP file into your resource packs folder.

If you placed the files in the correct locations but it still isn't working, try running the "**/datapack enable...**" command and make sure that the required resource pack is enabled.

---

### Uninstallation

**To fully uninstall this mod/datapack and remove all traces of it...**

1. Type in this command: "**/function uhv:uninstall**"
2. Remove the mod/datapack from the folder you put it in during installation, or uninstall it via Modrinth.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Configuration</summary>

**The commands listed below can be used to configure certain features.**

> **/function uhv:config/snowstorms**
>
> Toggles whether or not lightning can strike during thunderstorms in snowy biomes. By default, this is toggled ON.

> **/function uhv:config/arid_storms**
>
> Toggles whether or not lightning can strike during thunderstorms in arid/dry-weather biomes. By default, this is toggled ON.

> **/function uhv:config/drw_swimming**
> 
> Cycles through three options:
> 
> 1. Drowned horses allow players to ride on them while underwater.
> 2. Drowned horses will swim if a player is riding on them while in deep water.
> 3. Drowned horses will kick players off upon being submerged underwater.
> 
> By default, option one is enabled.

> **/function uhv:config/non_drw_swimming**
>
> Cycles between two options:
>
> 1. Zombie, husk, & living horses will kick players off upon being submerged underwater.
> 2. Zombie, husk, & living horses are able to swim while a player is riding on them.
>
> By default, option one is enabled.

> **/function uhv:config/randomized_attributes**
> 
> Toggles whether or not undead horses the maximum health and movement speed of undead horses will be randomized upon spawning. When toggled off, you're also able to choose whether or not to reset the stats of currently spawned undead horses.
> 
> _When toggled off, you will also be given you option to reset the maximum health and speed stats of all undead horses to the default values._

> **/function uhv:config/gameplay_bonuses**
> 
> Toggles whether or not undead horses will receive gameplay bonuses when certain conditions are fulfilled.

> **/function uhv:config/spawn_uhv_horses**
>
> Cycles through four options:
> 
> 1. Zombie horses, drowned horses, and husk horses spawn in abandoned villages. Drowned horses spawn in underwater ruins.
> 2. Drowned horses spawn in underwater ruins.
> 3. Zombie horses, drowned horses, and husk horses spawn in abandoned villages.
> 4. Undead horses will not spawn in abandoned villages or underwater ruins.
> 
> By default, option one is enabled.

> **/function uhv:config/burn_uhv_horses**
> 
> Toggles whether or not undead horses will burn in direct daylight. By default, this is toggled OFF.

</details>

**Check the gallery for images, or keep reading for in-depth info!**

---

## Spawning

**Each time lightning strikes, there's a chance for an undead horse to spawn.**

How likely this is depends on several factors: the specific type of undead, the location where the lightning struck, and the current difficulty.

<details>
<summary>INFO - Spawning</summary>

For most of the undead horses, they each have a **1.125%** chance to spawn while on **easy** or **peaceful**. On **normal** difficulty, this percentage is boosted to **2.75%**, and on **hard** it's **4.5%**.

**The exceptions to this rule are the bogged horses, wither skeleton horses, and husk horses.**

**Bogged horses** have two different spawn rates:

If lightning strikes in a swamp, mangrove swamp, or mushroom fields biome, the chances are the same as previously mentioned. However, if lightning strikes a mushroom, mushroom block, or mycelium and it is **not** in a mushroom fields biome, a bogged horse will **always** spawn.

**Wither skeleton horses** have a **100%** chance to spawn whenever lightning strikes a ruined portal.

**Husk horses** have a **2.25%** chance on **easy** or **peaceful**, a **5.5%** chance on **normal**, and a **9%** chance on **hard**. This is to account for the less frequent lightning strikes in the dry-weather biomes where husk horses can spawn.

In vanilla, it actually isn't possible for lightning to strike in snowy or arid regions, however, this data pack changes that. It's now **equally as likely** for lightning to spawn during thunderstorms in snowy regions as in rainy ones, however, it's only **half as likely** for lightning to strike while in a dry-weather biome.

If you don't want to change the vanilla weather patterns at all, this feature can be toggled by using "**/function uhv:config/snowstorms**" and "**/function uhv:config/arid_storms**".

**The secondary requirements for the other undead horses are as follows:**

- **Drowned horses** spawn in ocean, river, and beach biomes.
- **Stray horses** spawn in snowy areas.
- And **zombie horses** will spawn anywhere.

_[(Skeleton horse spawning is unchanged, check the wiki for information)](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Skeleton_Horse#Spawning)_

</details>

---

**Undead horses are also able to spawn in certain structures.**

_This can be configured using "**/function uhv:config/spawn_uhv_horses**"._

<details>
<summary>INFO - Spawning</summary>

**Abandoned Villages:**

Per each animal pen/stables generated in an abandoned village, there's a 20% chance for no horses to spawn, a 40% chance for one horse to spawn, and a 40% chance for two horses to spawn.

The horses spawned will be either zombie horses, husk horses, or drowned horses depending on the spawn location.

**Underwater Ruins:**

Underwater ruins can either spawn as small ruins or as large ruins surrounded by smaller ruins. Each of these large ruins has a chance to spawn a drowned horse.

Per each large ruin, there's a 30% chance for no horses to spawn, a 60% chance for one horse to spawn, and a 10% chance for two horses to spawn. If the spawn location isn't underwater, no horses will be spawned.

</details>

---

## Undead Horse Traps

**If a player approaches an undead horse, they'll soon be in for a fight!**

Each undead variant will spawn a cavalry of four horsemen, each with varying equipment depending on the type of undead. All of their armor and weapons will be randomly enchanted as well.

**The drowned horsemen and the husk horsemen also come with a unique reward: explorer maps!** _**Where might these maps lead?**_

<details>
<summary>Where These Maps Might Lead</summary>

The map held by the **drowned** can lead to an **ocean monument, buried treasure, or ocean ruins.**

The map held by the **husks** can lead to a **desert temple, a mineshaft, or a desert village.**

When the horsemen first spawn, the map will check if the first option can be found within 50 chunks and has not yet been generated. If not, it'll check the second option, and if that fails, it'll check the third option. If all three options are unviable, the map will be left empty.

</details>

---

## "Boardwalks"

Drowned horsemen have an ability similar to the frost walker enchantment — except instead of creating frosted ice, they create a "boardwalk" made of spruce slabs. This boardwalk will disappear behind them as they move.

<details>
<summary>INFO - "Boardwalks"</summary>

Drowned horses will only create a boardwalk in these two situations:

1. They're a trapped horse which hasn't yet been approached by a player.
2. A drowned horseman is currently riding on them.

Any boardwalks created will be destroyed if either the drowned horse or their passenger dies.

If a player swims close below a drowned horse, the boardwalk will be removed, allowing the drowned to attack and preventing the player from being trapped underwater.

</details>
  
<details>
<summary>Why do these boardwalks exist?</summary>

Initially, I wanted the drowned horsemen to ride their horses underwater, however, drowned will **always** use their swimming animation while underwater — even if they're riding another entity. This looks incredibly silly, hence the decision to give them platforms instead of allowing them underwater.

I'm anticipating that once the _Mounts of Mayhem_ game drop is released, drowned will be updated to prioritize their riding animation over their swimming animation. If so, this mod/datapack will be updated as well, finally allowing drowned horsemen to ride underwater as I originally wanted them to.

If underwater horsemen are ever implemented, the boardwalks will remain as a toggleable option but will not be the default.

</details>

---

## Conversion

Like their humanoid counterparts, it's possible to convert certain types of undead horses into other variants. This includes all of the same conversions possible for humanoid undead, however, there's also certain methods which are exclusive to the undead horses.

<details>
<summary>INFO - Conversion</summary>

**Husk Horse -> Zombie Horse -> Drowned Horse:**

Submerge the horse underwater for 45 seconds. After the first 30 seconds the horse will begin to shake. Once 15 more seconds pass, they will be converted.

**Drowned Horse -> Zombie Horse -> Husk Horse:**

Use a sponge to dry out the horse. Each conversion requires 3 sponges. If the horse enters the water, the amount of sponges needed will be reset.

**Skeleton Horse -> Stray Horse:**

The horse needs to stand in powder snow for 22 total seconds. After the first 7 seconds they'll start shaking, and after the next 15 seconds the conversion will be completed.

**Skeleton Horse -> Bogged Horse:**

While in a swamp, submerge the horse underwater for 45 seconds. After the first 30 seconds the horse will begin to shake. Once 15 more seconds pass, they will be converted.

**Skeleton Horse -> Wither Skeleton Horse:**

Feed your horse a wither rose. They'll begin to shake and emit particles. After 7 seconds, the conversion will be completed.

</details>

---

## Curing

Curing a zombie horse and curing a zombie villager involve very similar processes and materials. However, a golden carrot will be required instead of a golden apple if you intend to cure a zombie horse.

First, the zombie horse will need to be weakened. The most convenient way to accomplish this is by using a splash potion of weakness. Next, feed a golden carrot to the horse. Once you do, it'll begin to shake violently, emitting golden particle effects. After 3-5 minutes, the conversion will be completed.

If gameplay bonuses are enabled, all formerly undead horses will be given a level 2 regeneration effect.

---

## Shearing / Bone Mealing

Using shears, you can harvest the mushrooms & the mossy "tails" which grow on the backs of bogged horses. Unlike with humanoid bogged, this isn't a permanent change! If you ever want to return your bogged horse to their former appearance, using bonemeal will do the trick nicely.

---

## Underwater Horses / Swimming Horses / Vanilla Horses

Two functions have been added which allow players to choose how horses interact with water. Using these functions will cycle through the available options, with the first option listed below being the default option.

"**/function uhv:config/drw_swimming**" toggles the behavior of **drowned horses**.
1. Drowned horses allow players to ride on them while underwater.
2. Drowned horses will swim if a player is riding on them while in deep water.
3. Drowned horses will kick players off upon being submerged underwater.

**NOTE:** If option 2 is enabled, drowned horses can still be ridden underwater. To do so, they'll need to already be submerged before mounting them.

"**/function uhv:config/non_drw_swimming**" toggles the behavior of **zombie horses**, **husk horses**, and **living horses**.
1. Zombie, husk, & living horses will kick players off upon being submerged underwater.
2. Zombie, husk, & living horses are able to swim while a player is riding on them.

---

## Randomized Attributes

In vanilla, skeleton and zombie horses will **always** have a maximum health of **15 points (7.5 hearts)** and a base speed stat of **0.2 units**. This differs greatly from living horses which can have a maximum health of **15 to 30 points** and a speed stat of **0.1125 to 0.3375 units**.

This mod/datapack gets rid of this disparity, changing it so that undead horses will have their attributes randomized upon spawning. The maximum and minimum values possible are the same as for their living counterparts.

Using "**/function uhv:config/randomized_attributes**" will toggle this feature on and off. Toggling it off will also give you the option to reset the maximum health and speed stats of all undead horses to the default values.

---

## Gameplay Bonuses

All of the undead horses have different gameplay bonuses which will give them an edge under certain circumstances.

<details>
<summary>INFO - Gameplay Bonuses</summary>

- **Zombie horses** and **skeleton horses** both receive a level 1 speed boost during the night. _Night lasts from the moment that undead stop burning (12,542 ticks) until they start burning again in the morning (23,460 ticks)._

- **Drowned horses** have been given level 3 depth strider and a level 1 speed boost while in ocean, river, or beach biomes, as well as when they're in water. If submerged, they get a level 2 jump boost effect as well, useful for scaling steep underwater dropoffs.

- **Husk horses** receive a level 2 speed boost while in the desert or on sandy terrain. _This includes all variants of sand, sandstone, and terracotta._

- **Stray horses** have been given level 1 frost walker as well as a level 1 speed boost while on snowy or icy terrain. They also won't sink in powder snow!

- **Bogged horses** receive level 3 depth strider as well as a level 2 speed boost while in swamp biomes or on certain types of terrain. _This includes mushroom blocks, mycelium, mud, rooted dirt, podzol, moss, farmland/crops, and everything mangrove related._

- **Wither skeleton horses** have been given level 2 soul speed as well as applying a level 1 wither effect to any entites within 16 blocks which attempt to attack the player currently riding on them.

---

If you're not a fan of these bonuses, that's fine too: just turn them off by using "**/function uhv:config/remove_bonuses**".

Doing so will remove _almost_ all gameplay bonuses — however, certain "inherent" abilities will not be removed. These abilities include **wither skeleton horses being immune to fire & withering** as well as **stray horses & skeleton horses being immune to freeze damage.**

</details>

---

## The Sun Is A Deadly Laser

Watch out! Undead aren't a fan of daylight. If exposed to the sun, most types of undead start to burn. This now includes all of the undead horses except for two: husk horses and wither skeleton horses.

If you'd prefer for your beloved steed not to be a galloping fire hazard, worry not: this feature is disabled by default. To enable it, use "**/function uhv:config/burn_uhv_horses**".

---

## Emissive Textures

Some of the new undead horses have emissive eyes and other such glowing details. In vanilla, none of their humanoid counterparts utilize emissive layers despite their designs suggesting that they should. 

For consistency, I'd suggest using a resource pack such as **[Glowing Entities](https://modrinth.com/project/pCcNx1Zg)** which makes these details emissive! Alternatively, you can disable the emissive layers via ETF/EMF's configuration screen.

---
---

Special thanks to the **[Minecraft Wiki](https://minecraft.wiki/)**, the **[Datapack Hub](https://datapack.wiki/)**, and all of the datapacks that I studied while putting this together! In particular, shout out to **[Horses Can Float](https://modrinth.com/project/MKFXH430)**, which helped a lot when I was figuring out how to get the drowned horses to swim consistently.

If anyone wants to take a peek at how this mod/datapack works, I've added notes to some of the mcfunction files to help clarify what each of the commands do!

undead-armies.title: Undead Armies
undead-armies.description: A mod focused on adding cooperation between entities to accomplish a specific target, inspired by strategies in real world armies.
undead-armies.body:
# THIS MOD IS BEING REWRITTEN
- This mod is currently being rewritten, it's recommended to wait for the rewrite to be finished.
- The rewrite should be done before ~~february~~ ~~march~~ ~~may~~ june 2026.
- As for the progress, Stacking & Mining is done, currently working on ramming (will be renamed to ram & trample).

Have you ever felt the undead mobs in minecraft were lacking intelligence? This mod fixes that! 

this mod enables undead mobs to work together to destroy a player or any other entity [such as iron golems]. Undead mobs can also do other things that help them destroy their targets.

# Features list
>### Stacking
>Undead mobs will climb on top of eachother to go through obstacles
>### Mining
>Undead mobs will mine their way in to their target
>### Sprinting
>Undead mobs will sprint to their target if their target is near.
>### Grab
>Undead mobs will grab their target if able to, inflicting slowness on their target and themselves.
>### Jumping
>Undead mobs can jump 2 block gaps
>### Multi targeting
>Groups of Undead mobs are now able to split into smaller groups to attack multiple targets at once
>### Ramming 
>A Group of Undead mobs can violently leap and crash into a block causing it to break if enough damage was done.
  
# Compatibility
- Practically compatible with any mod. [this mod only adds on existing minecraft code]
  
# Note
- This mod does not store any extra data! Therefore, if a mob was breaking a block and the server restarts, the progress of breaking that block will be reset!

# Find this mod on Curseforge
- Click [this](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/undead-armies)

rogues-and-warriors.description: 🗡️ Silent Blades, Mighty Blows - Dominate with martial skills!
rogues-and-warriors.body:
![](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/3MKqoGuP/images/fd4a9b21b12c18e1b4754fc8d106b9367877e3ce.png)

## 🗡️ Silent Blades, Mighty Blows - Dominate with martial skills

[![Modloader](https://img.shields.io/badge/Loader-Fabric%20|%20NeoForge%20|%20Forge-ecebe6?labelColor=263768&style=for-the-badge)](https://fabricmc.net/) [![SpellEngine](https://img.shields.io/badge/Ecosystem-Spell_Engine-orange?style=for-the-badge)](https://modrinth.com/mod/spell-engine) [![Discord](https://img.shields.io/discord/973561601519149057.svg?label=&logo=discord&logoColor=ffffff&color=7389D8&labelColor=6A7EC2&style=for-the-badge)](https://discord.gg/KN9b3pjFTM)

---

## ✨ Discover more of the RPG Series

| [![Archers](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/XIpMGI6r/images/cd19a95a79f1157b33f31818aa615a280b206912.png)](https://modrinth.com/mod/archers) | [![Paladins](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/XIpMGI6r/images/3f19359bfd7521ba17bec818f125e87e09ef277e.png)](https://modrinth.com/mod/paladins-and-priests) | [![Wizards](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/XIpMGI6r/images/a7da965aa108daf95c10448c01423be49ce2338d.png)](https://modrinth.com/mod/wizards) | [![Skill Tree](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/XIpMGI6r/images/3bc519f14fb3e8496f730e7fae961c0481c7368d.png)](https://modrinth.com/mod/skill-tree) |
|---|---|---|---|
| [![Jewelry](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/XIpMGI6r/images/747102d582732b8defa50a2c925c7d5a6f87d009.png)](https://modrinth.com/mod/jewelry) | [![Relics](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/XIpMGI6r/images/a62c4eb9400d2ee8349078125ba0ab8b22c4424e.png)](https://modrinth.com/mod/relics-rpg) | [![Arsenal](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/XIpMGI6r/images/59a1006dfd980ddb35b96cfd86d7c367dcde2a2b.png)](https://modrinth.com/mod/arsenal-rpg-series) | [![Armory](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/XIpMGI6r/images/135abbb9c6a50349714cbdc30d98b443fe28abf6.png)](https://modrinth.com/mod/armory-rpg-series) |

# 📦 Installation

### Required

- [Armor Model API](https://modrinth.com/mod/armor-model-api)
- [Spell Engine](https://modrinth.com/mod/spell-engine)

### Strongly recommended

- [Better Combat](https://modrinth.com/mod/better-combat) for proper weapon mechanics

# 🗡️ Features

This project adds RPG-style combat skill sets—commonly known as classes—, introducing rogue and warrior archetypes (inspired by World of Warcraft).

![](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/3MKqoGuP/images/224297ec1ea813688339665fc7d867399a88fe5d.jpeg)

## Skills

Become a true Rogue or Warrior by creating the respective Spell Book, and unlocking all of its powerful spells!

To do it, find a Spell Binding Table in village [Gazebos](https://modrinth.com/mod/gazebos), or build your own (just don't forget bookshelves around the Spell Binding Table).

To use the spell books: equip them and hold a weapon (vanilla, or even third party mods).

![](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/3MKqoGuP/images/b7ecf3316a744e203e4665cdeda295523a01974e.png)

### Rogue Manual

Offers rogue skills, focusing on evading attacks, tricking opponents.

Best used with dual wielded quick weapons (such as Daggers or Sickles).

![](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/3MKqoGuP/images/6f1832a855142588263f091b0f469405fb67a549.jpeg)

### Warrior Codex

Offers warrior skills, focusing on weakening and smashing opponents in various ways.

Best used with heavy, slow weapons (such as: Double Axes, Glaives, Claymores),

![](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/3MKqoGuP/images/3b71d537b0f4a1ab41ae9cfb329251dced69e4c7.jpeg)

## Weapons

Explore a whole arsenal of entirely new weapons, with varying characteristics and attack moves.

Some weapons are exclusively available when BetterEnd and BetterNether mods are installed.

Equipment bonuses are configureable in `config/rogues/items.json`.

![](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/3MKqoGuP/images/6b79d839b9a8912476e5ec965ee1ad0c42e1adf2.png)

## Armory

Explore new armor sets, designed to sinergize with different combat playstyles.

![](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/3MKqoGuP/images/e593d89d67e90f18bedabe74b3fae288530efbb3.png)

## Rebalanced enchantments

Rebalanced vanilla damage enchantments, so they scale equally for fast and slow weapons.

**Sharpness** grants +8% damage per level.

**Smite** grants +12% damage per level.

**Bane of Arthropods** grants +12% damage per level.

These changes are configurable in `config/rogues/tweaks.json`.

Disclaimer: on 1.21 and later versions, this is implemented by overriding vanilla enchantment data files. (Datapacks can be used to customize or restore the original behaviour)

![](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/3MKqoGuP/images/a2addaf1556fc85198fe4dcbf4c5a6f69e8b49ab.png)

## Extended dungeon loot

Find powerful weapons and armors in dungeon loot chests!

Loot table injections are configurable in `config/rpg_series/loot.json`.

![](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/899/321/loot_1000.png)

## New village structures

Find Barracks in villages, where rogue and warrior equipment are being sold!

The spawn weight and limit are configureable in `config/rogues/villages.json`.

![](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/3MKqoGuP/images/54911337554bc5f99d67904ab193671e0e0494c1.png)

# 🔧 Configuration

Skill use mechanics and HUD can be configured under **Mod Menu / Spell Engine / Settings**.

All skills are defined in data files, hence customisable via data packs. Find the original data files in the project source linked to this page.

Item attributes of wizard equipment, chest loot chances, village structure generation can be configured by changing config JSON files under `config/wizards/`

# Designed for multiplayer

Create your own RPG server. Using our promo code gets you cheaper prices and also supports us.

[![Get a server](https://www.bisecthosting.com/partners/custom-banners/88e9c178-fe70-4122-8b9b-97d2feb48c2a.png)](https://bisecthosting.com/RPG_SERIES)

# 🎁 Looking for even more content?

Discover a wide range of Spell Engine mods, made by our beloved partners!

| [![Anarchy](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/XvoWJaA2/images/82af4e5b72525719870d4c0fb9a4354df651a66f.png)](https://modrinth.com/mod/anarchy-rpg) | [![Mercenaries and Artificers](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/XvoWJaA2/images/6e92ba91e60dffc4b25997210c4e6d0f3e2c2c0b.png)](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/mercenaries-and-artificers) | [![Archers Expansion (More RPG Classes)](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/XvoWJaA2/images/60bdae137bd2eb540291dcd1cc700000111dc55d.png)](https://modrinth.com/mod/archers-expansion) | [![Berserker (More RPG Classes)](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/XvoWJaA2/images/1fceb26f1ab45aaa3bc4ec1cd012cc1322451926.png)](https://modrinth.com/mod/berserker-rpg-class) |
|---|---|---|---|
| [![Elemental Wizards (More RPG Classes)](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/XvoWJaA2/images/5a38c115a738598f3433e8f4ee7844062b322d0b.png)](https://modrinth.com/mod/elemental-wizards-rpg) | [![Forcemaster (More RPG Classes)](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/XvoWJaA2/images/06e3a59096406e655c7d1335c88cfce2c6ce3409.png)](https://modrinth.com/mod/forcemaster-rpg-class) | [![Witcher (More RPG Classes)](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/XvoWJaA2/images/01f2d8cc4a33135190f0e82dbd9f5557dcd5dab5.png)](https://modrinth.com/mod/witcher-rpg-class) | [![Death Knights](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/XIpMGI6r/images/cf9db2db218180f7f2c8c1d6a34aa4e8db955fae.png)](https://modrinth.com/mod/death-knights) |

lne-rogues.body:
## LNE x Rogues & Warriors (RPG-Series) Add-On💎🗡️
![Warrior Turret](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/JEvQhsp7/images/1d50e3002db572e8b621f142a6864191cdc276e4.png)

[![Fabric](https://img.shields.io/badge/loader-fabric-black?style=for-the-badge&labelColor=black&color=grey)](https://fabricmc.net/)
[![Curseforge](https://img.shields.io/badge/curseforge-black?style=for-the-badge&logo=curseforge&labelColor=black&color=grey)](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/archers-expansion)
[![Discord](https://img.shields.io/discord/1209063880790376468?style=for-the-badge&logo=discord&label=discord&labelColor=black&color=grey)](https://discord.com/invite/AShKd5XrTu)
[![KoFi](https://img.shields.io/badge/donations-black?style=for-the-badge&logo=kofi&labelColor=black&color=grey)](https://ko-fi.com/fichteee)
[![Github](https://img.shields.io/badge/github-black?style=for-the-badge&logo=github&labelColor=black&color=grey)](https://github.com/ProfessorFichte/LNE-Rogues-Add-On)

## 📂 Installation
### 🚨Required Mods
- [Rogues & Warriors](https://modrinth.com/mod/rogues-and-warriors) (RPG-Series)
- [Spell Engine](https://modrinth.com/mod/spell-engine)

### 🤝Integrated Compatibility
- [Loot & Explore](https://modrinth.com/mod/loot-n-explore) ( Additional Rogue & Warrior Weapons )


## 🕹️ Features
- Loot & Explore is only a optional Dependency, if you dont want the special Rogue & Warrior Weapons and just want the class related structures, you dont have to install the L&E Mod, or you can disable the equipment in the config.

### ⚔️Equipment

# ⚔️ Minecraft Warriors 3 (Minecraft Helden 3) 
## Bounties, Grappling Hooks and much more

# Kein Pemium verkauf!
> **The ultimate Season/PvP plugin for Paper servers (1.21.11+).**
> **Das ultimative Season-/PvP-Plugin für Paper-Server (1.21.11+).**

| | |
|---|---|
| 🟢 **Supported Versions** | Paper 1.21.11+ |
| 🧩 **Java** | 21 |
| 💾 **Storage** | SQLite (default) or YAML |
| 🌍 **Language** | English / Deutsch |
| 🔗 **Discord / Support & Shop** | https://discord.gg/Dqsd9pxwB6 |

# 🇬🇧 EN – English

## What is Warriors3?

**Warriors3** is a complete **Season/PvP plugin** for Paper servers. It turns your Minecraft server into a **competitive "Last Hero Standing" experience**: every player gets **limited blue hearts**, a **secret bounty target**, and must survive the season within a **playtime limit** while the **map is split into two halves** that merge after a set time.

Everything is **highly configurable** via `config.yml` – no coding required.

---

## Features

### 🩵 Blue Hearts (Custom Lives)
- Every player starts with a configurable number of **blue hearts** (`max-hearts`).
- **Lose a heart only when you die during combat** (while combat-tagged).
- **+1 bonus heart** for killing your bounty target.
- Hearts are shown in the **action bar** using a custom resource pack font (`minecraft:warriors3`).
- Configurable action when all hearts are gone: `NONE` / `SPECTATOR` / `BAN` / `CUSTOM_COMMAND`.

### ⚔️ Combat Tag
- Enter combat on PvP hit; the tag **stacks while both players fight each other**.
- Configurable base duration, max duration, and per-hit increment.
- **Container/GUI access is blocked while tagged** (toggleable).
- Clean removal when the timer expires.

### 🎯 Bounty System (Kopfgeld)
- At season start every player receives a **secret bounty target**.
- Target is **revealed after X days** (configurable).
- Kill your target → **+1 blue heart**.
- Modes: `RANDOM` assignment or `MANUAL` (admin set via `/warriors3 bounty set`).
- **Dynamic bounty heads**: real player head rendered into the resource pack and shown in the action bar (Premium).

### 📅 Season System
- One timestamp defines the whole season: **playtime limit, bounty reveal & border drop** all reference it.
- Auto-starts a new season if none is active.
- `/warriors3 start <seconds>` runs a **game-start countdown** with configurable actions:
  `START_SEASON` → `SPLIT_BORDER` → `RTP` → `APPLY_BORDER` → `DROP_BORDER`.
- **Random Teleport (RTP)** with configurable radius, spawn points and border-split awareness.

### ⏱️ Playtime Limit (Season Week)
- Only active during the **first week** after season start (`limited-period-days`).
- Daily limit per player with configurable **reset hour**.
- **Warnings** at configurable thresholds (e.g. 10 / 5 / 1 minute left).
- Action when the limit is reached: `KICK` / `SPECTATOR` / `CUSTOM_COMMAND`.

### 🗺️ Map Split / World Border
- The map is divided along the **X or Z axis** into **Half A & Half B**.
- Players are automatically balanced to a half on their first join.
- **Crossing is blocked** until the split drops automatically after `split-duration-days`.
- **Visible split wall**: a giant indestructible wall (configurable material, length, stop distance).
- **Generic world border** (independent of the split) also included.
- **Border drop** broadcast: *"The border has fallen! The map is now one shared world!"*

### 🪦 Graves
- Lost loot on death spawns in a **player-head grave block**.
- **Hologram** above the grave (owner, remaining time, protection state).
- Configurable lifetime, **max graves per player**, breakable/explosive, **auto-loot**.
- **Owner-only protection** for the first X seconds.
- **Particles** above the grave (Premium).

### 🎒 Backpacks
- Fully configurable **tiers** (size, item, recipe, permission, owner-only, filtered contents).
- **Paginated GUI** with custom filler / page buttons.
- Content preview in the item lore.
- **Blocked containers & materials** (no backpack inside backpacks/chests).
- Tier 2 & 3 are **Premium-only** (configurable).

### 🪝 Grappling Hooks
- Custom hooks in **4 tiers** (Copper / Iron / Gold / Diamond).
- Right-click to **throw**, right-click again to **reel in**, left-click a block to hook it, **sneak to climb**, fall damage protection while hooked.
- **Custom enchantments** shipped as a datapack: `agility`, `long_reach`, `gentle_touch`.
- **Loot**: hooks appear rarely in generated chests (configurable chance).
- **Premium-only** (configurable).

### ⚔️ Duels (1v1 & Team) — Premium
- Challenge any player with `/duel <player>` for a clean **1v1 duel** — **no blue heart loss**, regardless of the combat-tag/heart system.
- Both players get a **chat message with clickable Accept/Decline buttons**.
- **Team duels** via `/duel team`: pick your partner and opposing team in a GUI; every single participant must individually accept.
- **Auto-cancelled** if nobody lands a hit for a configurable **inactivity timeout** (default 5 minutes) — no winner/loser, no consequences.
- Fully configurable in `config.yml` (timeout, arena teleport, team size, request expiry).
- **Requires an active Premium license.**

### 🚫 Restriction System (Item Blacklist)
Individually toggleable bans with per-player messages:
- Netherite ❌ Nether ❌ Mace ❌ Totems ❌ Potions ❌ Villagers ❌ Mending ❌ Punch II bows ❌ Knockback II swords

### 🎨 Custom Resource Pack (Bundled & Auto-Served)
- The plugin ships its own resource pack and can **serve it via a built-in HTTP server** (no upload needed) or via an external URL.
- Custom items, GUI textures, heart font and **dynamic player heads** are included.
- **Force-accept** mode with `KICK` / `WARN_ONLY` / `NONE` on decline.
- Diagnostics: `/warriors3 packinfo`, `/warriors3 packresend`, `/warriors3 packtest`.

### 🏆 Leaderboards GUI !!BETA!!
- Open the in-game **leaderboards GUI** (Premium) via `/warriors3 leaderboard`.
^^**
- 
### 🔄 Modrinth Update Checker
- Automatic update check on startup + every 60 minutes.
- Admins are notified on join when a new version is available.
- Manual check: `/warriors3 update check`.

### ⚙️ Storage & Performance
- **SQLite** (default, `warriors3.db`) or **YAML** storage, switchable in config.
- Asynchronous persistence – no server lag.

---

## Premium License

Warriors3 is a **premium plugin** with a **free base version** and gated premium features. The base version includes all core systems (blue hearts, combat, bounties, season, playtime, border split, graves, backpacks tier 1, restrictions, resource pack, update checker).

### 💎 Premium Features
| Feature | Description |
|---|---|
| **Dynamic Bounty Heads** | Real player head shown in the action bar (instead of a text name) |
| **Glowing** | Glowing effect on your bounty target / killer |
| **Custom Kill Messages** | Personalized kill & death messages |
| **Gravestone Particles** | Particles above graves |
| **Custom Gravestone Hologram** | Custom hologram lines |
| **Premium Backpack Tiers** | Gold (27 slots) & Diamond (81 slots) backpacks |
| **Grappling Hooks** | All hook tiers + enchantments + loot |
| **Leaderboards GUI** | In-game leaderboards |
| **Duels (1v1 & Team)** | Challenge/team-duel other players, no heart loss |
| **Cosmetic Heart Color** | Alternate heart color via resource pack |
| **Custom Prefix** | Your own chat / kill prefix |
| **Premium Bypass (Restrictions)** | Optional pay-to-win toggles to bypass item bans |

### 🛒 How to Buy a License
1. Join our **Discord server**: **https://discord.gg/Dqsd9pxwB6**
2. Check the **#shop** channel.
3. Receive your **license key** after purchase.
4. Enter the key in `config.yml`:
   ```yaml
   premium:
     license-key: "YOUR-KEY-HERE"
   ```
5. Run `restarr` and `/premium` to verify.
   - `/warriors3 premium check` → re-validate the license manually.

> **No internet required at runtime:** the valid keys are embedded directly in the plugin and validated locally (async). No HTTP calls are made for license checks.

### 🔍 How to Check Your License Status
- As an admin: `/warriors3 premium check`

---

## Installation

1. Download the latest **Warriors3-1.x.x.jar** from Modrinth.
2. Stop your Paper server (1.21.11+).
3. Put the jar into your `plugins/` folder.
4. Start the server – Warriors3 generates its config files automatically.
5. Optional: configure `config.yml` and run `/warriors3 reload`.
6. Make sure your server can serve the resource pack (see `resourcepack` section in `config.yml`).

> **Requirement:** A **resource pack** is required for the full experience (custom hearts, items, bounty heads). The plugin offers both **self-hosted (built-in HTTP server)** and **external URL** modes.

---

## Commands

### Player Commands
| Command | Description | Permission |
|---|---|---|
| `/backpack` | Open your backpack / manage tiers | `warriors3.backpack` |
| `/premium` | Show your premium license status | `warriors3.use` |
| `/duel <player>` | Challenge a player to a 1v1 duel (Premium) | `warriors3.duel` |
| `/duel team` | Open the team duel selection GUI (Premium) | `warriors3.duel` |
| `/duel accept\|decline\|cancel` | Respond to / cancel a duel request | `warriors3.duel` |

### Admin Commands (`warriors3.admin`)
| Command | Description |
|---|---|
| `/warriors3 reload` | Reload all configs |
| `/warriors3 hearts <player> <amount>` | Set blue hearts |
| `/warriors3 bounty info [player]` | Show bounty info |
| `/warriors3 bounty set <hunter> <target>` | Set a bounty manually |
| `/warriors3 bounty test` | Test bounty display (own head) |
| `/warriors3 season start [force]` | Start / restart a season |
| `/warriors3 border drop` | Drop the split border immediately |
| `/warriors3 border set <size>` | Set generic world border size |
| `/warriors3 border center <x> <z> [world]` | Set border center |
| `/warriors3 border clear` | Remove the generic border |
| `/warriors3 border status` | Show border status |
| `/warriors3 border wall build\|clear\|near\|material <mat>` | Manage the split wall |
| `/warriors3 heads rebuild` | Rebuild the dynamic resource pack |
| `/warriors3 start [seconds]` | Start the game-start countdown |
| `/warriors3 rtp [player]` | Random-teleport players |
| `/warriors3 config set\|get\|list ...` | Edit config live (OP only) |
| `/warriors3 set <shortcut> ...` | Config shortcuts |
| `/warriors3 leaderboard` | Open leaderboards GUI |
| `/warriors3 grapplinghook give [player] <tier>` | Give a grappling hook |
| `/warriors3 backpack give <player> [tier]` | Give a backpack |
| `/warriors3 premium check` | Validate license (OP only) |
| `/warriors3 update check` | Check for updates |
| `/warriors3 packinfo` | Resource pack diagnostics |
| `/warriors3 packresend` | Re-send the pack to all players |
| `/warriors3 packtest` | Test the heart/bounty font glyphs |

---

## Permissions

| Permission | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `warriors3.admin` | OP | All admin commands |
| `warriors3.admin.config` | OP | `/warriors3 config` + `/warriors3 set` |
| `warriors3.use` | Everyone | Basic plugin usage |
| `warriors3.backpack` | Everyone | Open backpacks |
| `warriors3.backpack.give` | OP | Give backpacks |
| `warriors3.backpack.recipes` | Everyone | Show backpack recipes |
| `warriors3.backpack.bypass-owner` | OP | Open foreign owner-only backpacks |
| `warriors3.backpack.bypass-cooldown` | OP | Ignore backpack cooldown |
| `warriors3.backpack.craft.<tier>` | – | Craft backpack tier |
| `warriors3.backpack.use.<tier>` | – | Use backpack tier |
| `warriors3.combat.test` | OP | `/combat` test commands |

---

## Configuration

Everything is stored in `plugins/Warriors3/config.yml` and `messages.yml`. Highlights:

```yaml
hearts:
  max-hearts: 3          # starting blue hearts
  on-zero-action: BAN    # NONE | SPECTATOR | BAN | CUSTOM_COMMAND

combat:
  tag-duration-seconds: 30
  max-tag-duration-seconds: 350

playtime:
  enabled: true
  limited-period-days: 7      # limit active only in the first week
  daily-limit-minutes: 60
  limit-reached-action: KICK  # KICK | SPECTATOR | CUSTOM_COMMAND

border:
  split-duration-days: 14     # border drops automatically after this
  border-center-axis: x       # split along x or z

bounty:
  assignment-mode: RANDOM     # RANDOM | MANUAL
  reveal-after-days: 14

graves:
  enabled: true
  time-seconds: 900

storage:
  type: sqlite               # sqlite | yaml
```

**Placeholders** in messages: `%player%`, `%target%`, `%hearts%`, `%seconds%`, `%minutes%`, `%days%`, `%limit%`, `%discord%`, `%x%`, `%y%`, `%z%`, `%world%`, `%victim%`, `%attacker%`, `%owner_name_display%` and more.

**Colors:** Minecraft color codes like `&c`, `&6`, `&l`, `&o`, `&n` are supported everywhere.

---

## FAQ (EN)

**Q: Which server software do I need?**
A: Paper 1.21.11 or newer (fork like Purpur/Pufferfish also works).

**Q: Is the plugin free?**
A: Yes, the base version is free. Premium features require a license key.

**Q: Where do I buy a license?**
A: In our Discord: https://discord.gg/Dqsd9pxwB6

**Q: Does the plugin phone home?**
A: No. License validation is done **locally** against keys embedded in the plugin. The only internet connection is the optional Modrinth update check.

**Q: Do I need to host a resource pack?**
A: Yes, but Warriors3 can serve it for you via a built-in HTTP server – no external upload required. (Open the configured port on your host/router.)

---

# 🇩🇪 DE – Deutsch

## Was ist Warriors3?

**Warriors3** ist ein komplettes **Season-/PvP-Plugin** für Paper-Server. Es verwandelt deinen Server in ein kompetitives **„Last Hero Standing"-Erlebnis**: Jeder Spieler hat **limitierte blaue Herzen**, ein **geheimes Kopfgeld-Ziel** und muss die Season innerhalb eines **Playtime-Limits** überleben, während die **Map in zwei Hälften geteilt** ist, die nach einer bestimmten Zeit zusammenfallen.

Alles ist über `config.yml` **hochkonfigurierbar** – ohne Codekenntnisse.

---

## Features (DE)

### ❤️ Blaue Herzen (Custom-Leben)
- Jeder Spieler startet mit einer konfigurierbaren Anzahl **blauer Herzen** (`max-hearts`).
- **Herzverlust NUR bei Tod im Combat-Tag**.
- **+1 Bonus-Herz** für den Kill des eigenen Kopfgeld-Ziels.
- Anzeige in der **Actionbar** über einen Custom-Font des Resourcepacks (`minecraft:warriors3`).
- Konfigurierbare Aktion bei 0 Herzen: `NONE` / `SPECTATOR` / `BAN` / `CUSTOM_COMMAND`.

### ⚔️ Combat-Tag
- Kampfstart bei PvP-Treffer; der Tag **stackt bei gegenseitigem Kampf**.
- Konfigurierbare Basis-Dauer, Maximum und Zuwachs.
- **Container/GUI-Zugriff wird im Kampf blockiert** (abschaltbar).
- Sauberes Entfernen, wenn der Timer abläuft.

### 🎯 Kopfgeld-System (Bounty)
- Jeder Spieler bekommt zu Season-Start ein **geheimes Kopfgeld-Ziel**.
- Das Ziel wird **nach X Tagen enthüllt** (konfigurierbar).
- Kill des Ziels → **+1 blaues Herz**.
- Modi: `RANDOM` (zufällig) oder `MANUAL` (Admin setzt per `/warriors3 bounty set`).
- **Dynamische Bounty-Köpfe**: echter Spielerkopf wird ins Resourcepack gebacken und in der Actionbar angezeigt (Premium).

### 📅 Season-System
- Ein Zeitstempel steuert die ganze Season: **Playtime-Limit, Bounty-Reveal & Border-Drop** beziehen sich darauf.
- Startet automatisch eine neue Season, wenn keine aktiv ist.
- `/warriors3 start <sekunden>` startet einen **Game-Start-Countdown** mit konfigurierbaren Aktionen:
  `START_SEASON` → `SPLIT_BORDER` → `RTP` → `APPLY_BORDER` → `DROP_BORDER`.
- **Random Teleport (RTP)** mit konfigurierbarem Radius, Spawnpunkten und Border-Split-Bewusstsein.

### ⏱️ Playtime-Limit (Season-Woche)
- Nur in der **ersten Woche** nach Season-Start aktiv (`limited-period-days`).
- Tageslimit pro Spieler mit konfigurierbarer **Reset-Stunde**.
- **Warnungen** bei konfigurierbaren Schwellen (z. B. 10 / 5 / 1 Minute Restzeit).
- Aktion bei Erreichen des Limits: `KICK` / `SPECTATOR` / `CUSTOM_COMMAND`.

### 🗺️ Map-Split / Worldborder
- Die Map wird entlang der **X- oder Z-Achse** in **Hälfte A & Hälfte B** geteilt.
- Spieler werden beim ersten Join automatisch auf eine Hälfte verteilt.
- **Überqueren wird blockiert**, bis die Grenze nach `split-duration-days` automatisch fällt.
- **Sichtbare Trennwand**: eine riesige unzerstörbare Wand (Material, Länge, Stop-Distanz konfigurierbar).
- Zusätzlich eine **generische Worldborder** (unabhängig vom Split).
- **Border-Drop** Broadcast: *„Die Grenze ist gefallen! – die Map ist jetzt eine gemeinsame Welt!"*

### 🪦 Gräber (GravesX-Stil)
- Verlorener Loot spawnt bei Tod als **Kopf-Block-Grab**.
- **Hologramm** über dem Grab (Besitzer, Restzeit, Schutzstatus).
- Konfigurierbare Lebensdauer, **max. Gräber pro Spieler**, abbaubar/explosionsfähig, **Auto-Loot**.
- **Owner-only-Schutz** für die ersten X Sekunden.
- **Partikel** über dem Grab (Premium).

### 🎒 Rucksäcke (BackpackPlus-Port)
- Voll konfigurierbare **Stufen** (Größe, Item, Rezept, Permission, Owner-only, gefilterter Inhalt).
- **Paginiertes GUI** mit eigenen Filler-/Seiten-Buttons.
- Inhalts-Übersicht in der Item-Lore.
- **Blockierte Container & Materialien** (keine Rucksäcke in Rucksäcken/Truhen).
- Stufe 2 & 3 sind **Premium-only** (konfigurierbar).

### 🪝 Grappling Hooks (YoHooks-Port)
- Custom-Hooks in **4 Stufen** (Kupfer / Eisen / Gold / Diamant).
- Rechtsklick: **werfen** | nochmal Rechtsklick: **einholen** | Linksklick auf Block: **an blocken** | **Sneak: klettern** | Fallschaden-Schutz am Haken.
- **Custom-Verzauberungen** per Datapack: `agility`, `long_reach`, `gentle_touch`.
- **Loot**: Hooks erscheinen selten in generierten Truhen (Chance konfigurierbar).
- **Premium-only** (konfigurierbar).

### ⚔️ Duelle (1v1 & Team) — Premium
- Fordere andere Spieler mit `/duel <spieler>` zu einem sauberen **1v1-Duell** heraus — **kein Verlust blauer Herzen**, unabhängig vom Combat-Tag-/Herzsystem.
- Beide Spieler bekommen eine **Chat-Nachricht mit klickbaren Annehmen-/Ablehnen-Buttons**.
- **Team-Duelle** per `/duel team`: Partner und Gegner-Team über ein GUI auswählen; jeder Beteiligte muss einzeln zustimmen.
- **Automatischer Abbruch**, wenn niemand innerhalb eines konfigurierbaren **Inaktivitäts-Timeouts** (Standard 5 Minuten) angreift — kein Sieger/Verlierer, keine Konsequenzen.
- Vollständig konfigurierbar in `config.yml` (Timeout, Arena-Teleport, Team-Größe, Anfrage-Ablaufzeit).
- **Benötigt eine aktive Premium-Lizenz.**

### 🚫 Restriktions-System (Item-Blacklist)
Einzeln abschaltbare Verbote mit eigenen Spieler-Nachrichten:
- Netherite ❌ Nether ❌ Mace ❌ Totems ❌ Tränke ❌ Dorfbewohner ❌ Mending ❌ Punch II Bögen ❌ Knockback II Schwerter

### 🎨 Custom-Resourcepack (gebündelt & automatisch ausgeliefert)
- Das Plugin bringt sein eigenes Resourcepack mit und kann es per **eingebautem HTTP-Server** ausliefern (kein Upload nötig) oder über eine externe URL.
- Custom-Items, GUI-Texturen, Herz-Font und **dynamische Spielerköpfe** sind enthalten.
- **Force-Accept**-Modus mit `KICK` / `WARN_ONLY` / `NONE` bei Ablehnung.
- Diagnose: `/warriors3 packinfo`, `/warriors3 packresend`, `/warriors3 packtest`.

### 🏆 Leaderboards-GUI
- Öffne das **Leaderboards-GUI** im Spiel (Premium) per `/warriors3 leaderboard`.

### 🔄 Modrinth-Update-Checker
- Automatischer Update-Check beim Start + alle 60 Minuten.
- Admins werden beim Join informiert, wenn eine neue Version verfügbar ist.
- Manueller Check: `/warriors3 update check`.

### ⚙️ Speicher & Performance
- **SQLite** (Standard, `warriors3.db`) oder **YAML**-Speicher, in der Config umschaltbar.
- Asynchrones Speichern – kein Server-Lag.

---

## Premium-Lizenz

Warriors3 ist ein **Premium-Plugin** mit einer **kostenlosen Basis-Version** und geschützten Premium-Features. Die Basis-Version enthält alle Kernsysteme (Blaue Herzen, Combat, Bounties, Season, Playtime, Border-Split, Gräber, Rucksack Stufe 1, Restriktionen, Resourcepack, Update-Checker).

### 💎 Premium-Features
| Feature | Beschreibung |
|---|---|
| **Dynamische Bounty-Köpfe** | Echter Spielerkopf in der Actionbar (statt Textname) |
| **Glowing** | Glow-Effekt auf Kopfgeld-Ziel / Killer |
| **Custom-Kill-Messages** | Eigene Kill-/Death-Nachrichten |
| **Grab-Partikel** | Partikel über Gräbern |
| **Custom-Grab-Hologramm** | Eigene Hologramm-Zeilen |
| **Premium-Rucksack-Stufen** | Goldener (27 Slots) & Diamant-Rucksack (81 Slots) |
| **Grappling Hooks** | Alle Hook-Stufen + Verzauberungen + Loot |
| **Leaderboards-GUI** | Leaderboards im Spiel |
| **Duelle (1v1 & Team)** | Andere Spieler herausfordern/Team-Duelle, kein Herzverlust |
| **Kosmetische Herzfarbe** | Andere Herzfarbe über das Resourcepack |
| **Custom-Präfix** | Eigener Chat-/Kill-Präfix |
| **Premium-Bypass (Restriktionen)** | Optionale Pay-to-Win-Schalter, um Item-Verbote zu umgehen |

### 🛒 So kaufst du eine Lizenz
1. Tritt unserem **Discord-Server** bei: **https://discord.gg/Dqsd9pxwB6**
2. Erstelle ein Ticket / schau in den **#shop**-Kanal.
3. Du erhältst nach dem Kauf deinen **Lizenz-Key**.
4. Trage den Key in `config.yml` ein:
   ```yaml
   premium:
     license-key: "DEIN-KEY-HIER"
   ```
5. Führe `/warriors3 reload` aus oder prüfe per `/premium`.
   - `/warriors3 premium check` → Lizenz manuell neu validieren.

> **Kein Internet zur Laufzeit nötig:** Die gültigen Keys sind direkt im Plugin eingebettet und werden lokal (async) validiert. Für die Lizenzprüfung werden KEINE HTTP-Calls gemacht.

## Installation (DE)

1. Lade das aktuelle **Warriors3.jar** von Modrinth herunter.
2. Stoppe deinen Paper-Server (1.21.11+).
3. Lege die JAR in deinen `plugins/`-Ordner.
4. Starte den Server – Warriors3 erstellt seine Config-Dateien automatisch.
5. Optional: `config.yml` anpassen und `/warriors3 reload` ausführen.
6. Stelle sicher, dass dein Server das Resourcepack ausliefern kann (siehe `resourcepack`-Abschnitt in `config.yml`).

> **Anforderung:** Ein **Resourcepack** wird für das volle Erlebnis benötigt (Custom-Herzen, Items, Bounty-Köpfe). Das Plugin unterstützt sowohl **Self-Hosted (eingebauter HTTP-Server)** als auch **externe URL**.

### Admin-Befehle (`warriors3.admin`)

## Konfiguration (DE)

Alles liegt in `plugins/Warriors3/config.yml` und `messages.yml`. Auszug:

```yaml
hearts:

  on-zero-action: BAN    # NONE | SPECTATOR | BAN | CUSTOM_COMMAND

combat:
  tag-duration-seconds: 30

mc-warriors-1.body:
# MC Warriors 1



Premium & Bug Report: https://discord.gg/pxSJynZC6X

## 🇬🇧 English:


A Fabric mod for PvP projects featuring a lives system, combat timer, and graves. It brings important project announcements directly into the game and can automatically ban eliminated players from the server.

## Features

- **Lives System:** Configure the starting number of lives. Players can lose a life when dying in combat.
- **Elimination at Zero Lives:** Players who lose all their lives are automatically banned from the server.
- **Revival:** Revive eliminated players using a command and automatically remove their ban.
- **Combat Timer:** After PvP hits, players remain in combat for a configurable duration. The remaining time is displayed in the action bar.
- **Moderate Time Extension:** After every 5–9 hits, the combat timer is randomly extended by 10–30 seconds.
- **Graves:** Items are stored in a grave upon death. When dying in combat, the player keeps a portion of their items, while the rest is placed in the grave.
- **Death Screen Animation:** An optional animation plays once.
- **Server Configuration:** Customize lives, combat duration, HUD, graves, and other rules through `config/helden/config.yml`.
- **Premium Support:** Premium features can be unlocked using a valid key server key.

## Installation

1. Install **Fabric Loader** for Minecraft **1.21.11**.
2. Install **Fabric API** on the server and all clients.
3. Place the mod JAR in the `mods` folder on the server and on every client.
4. Start the server once to generate the configuration file.

> The mod must be installed on both the server and every client.

## Commands

All commands start with `/helden`. Administrative commands require sufficient permissions.

| Command | Description |
|---|---|
| `/helden premium` | Displays the premium status |
| `/helden premium set <KEY>` | Saves and validates a premium key |
| `/helden premium info` | Displays the server ID and masked key |
| `/helden lives <Player>` | Displays a player's remaining lives |
| `/helden setlives <Player> <Amount>` | Sets a player's lives |
| `/helden addlives <Player> <Amount>` | Adds lives to a player |
| `/helden removelives <Player> <Amount>` | Removes lives from a player |
| `/helden resetlives <Player>` | Resets a player's lives to the starting amount |
| `/helden revive <Player>` | Revives an eliminated player and removes their ban |
| `/helden combat <Player>` | Displays the remaining combat time |
| `/helden combat clear <Player>` | Clears a player's combat status |
| `/helden combat set <Player> <Seconds>` | Sets a player's combat timer |

## Configuration

The file `config/helden/config.yml` is generated on the first server startup. The premium key can be configured under `premium.key`:

```yaml
premium:
  key: ""
debug: false
```





## 🇩🇪 German: 

# Minecraft Helden 1

Eine Fabric-Mod für PvP-Projekte mit Leben-System, Kampf-Timer und Gräbern. Sie bringt wichtige Projektmeldungen direkt ins Spiel und kann ausgeschiedene Spieler automatisch vom Server bannen.

## Features

- **Leben-System:** Lege die Startanzahl an Leben fest. Bei einem Tod im Kampf kann ein Leben verloren gehen.
- **Ausscheiden bei null Leben:** Spieler, die alle Leben verlieren, werden automatisch gebannt.
- **Wiederbelebung:** Mit einem Befehl können ausgeschiedene Spieler wiederbelebt und automatisch entbannt werden.
- **Kampf-Timer:** Spieler bleiben nach PvP-Treffern für eine festgelegte Zeit im Kampf. Die verbleibende Zeit wird in der Actionbar angezeigt.
- **Moderate Zeitverlängerung:** Nach jeweils 5–9 Treffern verlängert sich die Kampfzeit zufällig um 10–30 Sekunden.
- **Gräber:** Beim Tod werden Items in einem Grab abgelegt. Bei einem Tod im Kampf behält der Spieler einen Teil seiner Items; der Rest landet im Grab.
- **Deathscreen-Animation:** Eine optionale Animation wird einmal abgespielt.
- **Server-Konfiguration:** Passe Leben, Kampfzeit, HUD, Gräber und weitere Regeln über `config/helden/config.yml` an.
- **Premium-Unterstützung:** Premium-Funktionen können mit einem gültigen Keyserver-Key freigeschaltet werden.

## Installation

1. Installiere **Fabric Loader** für Minecraft **1.21.11**.
2. Installiere **Fabric API** auf dem Server und auf allen Clients.
3. Lege die Mod-JAR in den `mods`-Ordner des Servers und der Clients.
4. Starte den Server einmal, damit die Konfiguration erstellt wird.

> Die Mod muss auf dem Server und auf jedem Client installiert sein.

## Befehle

Alle Befehle beginnen mit `/helden`. Die Verwaltung ist auf Spieler mit ausreichenden Rechten beschränkt.

| Befehl | Funktion |
|---|---|
| `/helden premium` | Zeigt den Premium-Status |
| `/helden premium set <KEY>` | Speichert und prüft einen Premium-Key |
| `/helden premium info` | Zeigt Server-ID und maskierten Key |
| `/helden lives <Spieler>` | Zeigt die verbleibenden Leben |
| `/helden setlives <Spieler> <Anzahl>` | Setzt die Leben eines Spielers |
| `/helden addlives <Spieler> <Anzahl>` | Fügt Leben hinzu |
| `/helden removelives <Spieler> <Anzahl>` | Entfernt Leben |
| `/helden resetlives <Spieler>` | Setzt die Leben auf den Startwert zurück |
| `/helden revive <Spieler>` | Belebt einen ausgeschiedenen Spieler wieder und hebt den Bann auf |
| `/helden combat <Spieler>` | Zeigt die verbleibende Kampfzeit |
| `/helden combat clear <Spieler>` | Beendet den Kampfstatus |
| `/helden combat set <Spieler> <Sekunden>` | Setzt die Kampfzeit |

## Konfiguration

Die Datei `config/helden/config.yml` wird beim ersten Serverstart erstellt. Der Premium-Key kann dort unter `premium.key` eingetragen werden:

```yaml
premium:
  key: ""
debug: false

warriorsplits.title: WarriorSplits
warriorsplits.description: A in-game timer for speedrunning Parkour Warrior on MCCI!
warriorsplits.body:
A mod for [MCC Island](https://mcchampionship.com/)'s Parkour Warrior adding an in-game speedrun timer.

No setup required at all, install the mod and enjoy the timer in the right top of your screen. The mod will automatically detect which course you are on.

## Commands
* `/timer start` Starts the timer.
* `/timer split` Moves to the next segment.
* `/timer reset` Resets the timer.
* `/timer setcourse <course>` Manually overrides the course.
* `/timer setcomparison <pb|gold>` Sets your comparison run to either your personal best or your ideal run on a per-obstacle basis.

## Save files
Your times get stored in JSON files in your config folder. You can find it at `%appdata%/.minecraft/config/warriorsplits`. There'll be a month folder in which for each month all the courses get stored. You shouldn't have to edit these manually.

guts.title: Give Us Terracotta Stairs! (G.U.T.S)
guts.description: Simply adds Terracotta block variants (Stairs, Slabs, Walls), and that's it, no extra fluff.
guts.body:
## Description
Other mods that add terracotta block variants either have too much fluff, or arent up to date.
This mod was made to do one thing, and one thing only. It adds Terracotta Stairs, Slabs, and Walls. And that's it.
![GUTS Blocks](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d6a5744409c988057ac66b513c3c8faa94d65199_0.webp)
## FAQ
**Q: How does texture pack support work?**
> A: GUTS pulls directly from the terracotta textures, so any texture pack that changes terracotta will also change the additional blocks.

**Q: Version Support? Ports to 1.X.X?**
> A: My goal is to support every version that I can from 1.21 onward. Though it may take a while if Mojang decides to change a lot on the backend (like in 1.21.3).
>
> As for backports, we will see.

**Q: Other modloaders? Neoforge?**
> A: While Neoforge is not officially supported, [Sinytra Connector](https://modrinth.com/mod/connector) should work since GUTS is a fairly simple mod.

**Q: HELP! I've Encountered a bug! / Something doesn't work!**
> A: If you encounter any issues at all, please don't be afraid to join [the discord](https://discord.com/invite/VdtQBPY) and submit a bug report.

# Allows re-dye-ing glazed terracotta

### Note:

This datapack adds recipes, removing this datapack will cause warnings to appear in console about missing recipes. This is not dangerous to your world or save info.

### Installation (Fabric/Forge/Quilt):
These will act functionally the same as the datapack, but apply to all worlds that are created/enabled with this mod installed. If you do not want this to apply to all worlds, use the datapack instead

**Forge**:
No dependencies required, just place the mod into the "mods" folder

**Fabric**:
Requires [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api)

**Quilt**:
Requires [Quilted Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/qsl)


### PurpurPacks
PurpurPacks are features that have been suggested to be added to the [Purpur](https://purpurmc.org/) server software - or would fit Purpur's theme, but were decided would fit better as a datapack!

Each datapack functions the same as a singular configuration setting would in Purpur. They can be added and removed at any time without damaging the server.

These datapacks do not depend on Purpur; they work completely fine in vanilla or any other server software.

terracotta-shingles.description: Decorate your builds with the vibrancy of colourful roof tiles!
terracotta-shingles.body:
# Terracotta Shingles

# 🎨 Variants
 Adding **17 variants** to decorate your builds with! Make your roofs stand out by giving them the hue and vibrancy of Terracotta, with **Walls, Slabs & Stairs** so you can build in all shapes and sizes. 
![Kai, barely visible, standing under a roof made out of Light Blue & Green Terracotta Shingle Stairs](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/fa7524aacb5aee2e95496511283cfb851a5e1e93.png)

---
# ⚒️ Crafting & dyeing
You can **craft** Terracotta into Terracotta Shingles by combining Terracotta in a 2x2 grid in your Inventory or Crafting Table! You can also dye unstained Terracotta Shingles in the same way as you would Terracotta (this works for Walls, Slabs & Stairs too!).\
ℹ️ *If you would like to **universally dye** (a.k.a. regardless of the existing colour of the input) your Terracotta Shingles, you can enable this via the optional*  ```terracotta_shingles:universal_dyeing``` *datapack!*
![1. Crafting Table GUI with White Dye in the center slot, surrounded by Terracotta Shingles in all 8 slots, showing an output of 8 White Terracotta Shingles. 2. Survival Inventory GUI with 4 Blue Terracotta in the 4 crafting slots, showing an output of 4 Blue Terracotta Shingles. 3. Outside of the GUI's Sunny is looking down at a Crafting Table and Ari is looking down into her hands](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d56b92db3c9d9f58ecfde148e2e6d57a89f92ae1.png)

---
# 👷🏽 Stonecutting & Mason
The **Stonecutter** allows you to cut Terracotta straight into Terracotta Shingles and its variants! Meanwhile, an expert level Mason can also give you access to a random color of Terracotta Shingles!

![1. Stonecutter GUI with Cyan Terracotta as input on the left, 4 options in the center (Cyan Terracotta Shingle Slab, Cyan Terracotta Shingle Stairs (selected), Cyan Terracotta Shingle Wall, Cyan Terracotta Shingles), and Cyan Terracotta Shingle Stairs as output on the right. 2. A Trading GUI with 3 options on the left (Emerald -> 10 Bricks, Emerald -> Magenta Terracotta Shingles (selected), Emerald -> Lime Terracotta), in the left input slots are 3 Emeralds, in the output slot is Magenta Terracotta Shingles. The XP-bar is filled for about 20%, and the Mason is an expert. 3. Outside of the GUI's there is an animated stonecutter and a Plains Mason looking up at the trading GUI](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e88a0c266b97f9a3997fa3c53cdd249808d6bef5.webp)

---
# 🎵 Unique Sounds 
Noise! Terracotta Shingles come with **Unique Sounds** to satisfy your ears with and immerse yourself into the world!

![A platform of Light Gray Terracotta Shingles, with Steve walking on it and Alex placing an Orange Terracotta Shingle Wall on it. Both actions have music notes around them to indicate that they make noise](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d8d187f2ddccd40a8b25c75a6419481caec73936.png)

terracotta-knights.title: Terracotta Knights
terracotta-knights.description: A clay soldiers remake! Customize their armor, their color, their weaponry, and make them fight!
terracotta-knights.body:
Terracotta Knights
===

Terracotta Knights is inspired by the original Clay Soldiers mod by SanAndreaP. The mod is currently in development and is only offered in creative for right now. The only crafting recipe that's available is dyeing your knights.

## Features

#### *Dyeing Knights:*
Knights can come with a variety of colors using the vanilla minecraft dyes. To dye your terracotta knight, insert one of the knights with the desired dye of your choice in a crafting table.

![Dying knights in crafting table](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/GgTW6G1d/images/c2ae5674587e5dbb99bdb711e97f56169cc08b0f.gif)

Different colored knights **WILL** fight each other to the death.

#### *Using the remote:*
The signal device will kill knights in a 30 by 30 radius!

![Killing knights with remote](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/GgTW6G1d/images/b21f59227d9e7c34ca78bcb7be24e51c66a2edfc.gif)


Equipped knights will drop their armor and weapons using the remote.
![Knights equip and drop armor](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/GgTW6G1d/images/818d191f427e1cb8e7092697ceb94ae193a89d08.gif)





There are easter eggs to be found by naming knights 👀



Coming Soon
---
* Horses
* Crossbows
* Stackable Armor
* Shields
* Powerups
* Full Recipes 

## Dependencies

QFAPI/QSL

mischief-illagers.title: Mischief Illagers
mischief-illagers.description: Adds new custom Illagers, structures and items!
mischief-illagers.body:
![Title](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/BiEgQKpJ/images/b1df9b12c70fc540de340cc2d265067e9cea4786.png)

- **_Mod requires [Geckolib](https://modrinth.com/mod/geckolib/versions) to work!_**
- **_Join my [Discord](https://discord.gg/pEEN9S65xU) to see mod progress I suppose_**
- **_The mod is currently undergoing an update which will overhaul many things!_**

Mischief Illagers is a mod that adds new custom Illagers, 4 new structures and a few items, to make raids and exploration harder and a bit more interesting!

---------------

**This mod adds a total of 12 new Illagers, each having unique abilities!**
<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

![All the new Illagers](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/BiEgQKpJ/images/fbcc94511ec4e40eaac856628de0bf2388884c03.png)

**Mischiever:** An evil troublemaker that throws dynamite which combusts and weakens anyone in the blast radius. At one point, it will vanish and turn invisible for a short period of time

**Partyger:** This illager enjoys to party during raids, gifting you a ton of confetti and exploding gifts!

**Imprecator:** A sort of alchemist who throws potions at you and can cast a spell that you should block with a shield or else await getting shocked. Imprecator easily gets distracted by allays, but be aware, if an Allay gets shocked it'll turn into Vex!

**Withermancer:** A grumpy illager who casts flames and withering on its foes, doing it directly

**Libravoker:** An Evoker who spent most of its spare time in a library, now summoning fangs right under your feet and throwing flying books instead of vexes right at you!

**Bass Blaster:** An illager that carries a modified jukebox to blast its target into the air and everyone else away with it!

**Sparkologer:** This illager will simply try to kill you with an iron sword, however it will also dash towards you and jump high to avoid getting hit

**Magnetizer:** Runs around placing magnets that can magnetize mobs and players around, if you are able to avoid the magnet, be ready for Magnetizer to pull you to itself to prevent you from attacking its friends. If its close to death then it will push you away instead

**Photographer:** Will make sure to picture the best moments of, ur   ,su fer inĝ, (brightens your screen)

**Doodler:** Creative Illager uses its imagination and a pencil to draw a doodle replica of either a Creeper, Pillager or Vex, the doodle replicas are notable for being weaker than their original counterpart, but can still be a problem

**Bubbleologer:** Don't judge this fella by its a bit silly looking weapon, as Bubbleologer can jump around you and blast water and giant bubbles, dealing quite a decent damage

**Fangclaw:** A vindicator that lost its arm now has evocation fangs as a replacement. Fangclaw is very tough, despite unable to disable shields, its able to charge at you, making the situation worse
</details>

Additionally, vanilla illagers (except Pillager) and Witch textures were slightly changed and polished
<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

![Changed Illagers (and Witch)](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/36cc18d18b89465f77e74bcee552402cba088528.png)
</details>

---------------

**Several new items and 4 structures are also in this mod!**

_Items:_
<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

All items listed below (excluding Party Horn) can be crafted or dropped from some Illagers!
  
**Imprecation dust:** can be used to make a new potion that gives a new effect - "Shocking" and bad luck. If you put the dust into drinkable potion of shocking, you'll get furious brew, which gives very strong effects with a slight payoff for a while!

**Crazy Dynamite:** can be thrown, it bounces of the ground and moves constantly, before exploding and giving weakness to the ones caught in the explosion

**Magnetizing Magnet:** can be thrown and act just like Magnetizer's magnet, the good part? It sucks in hostile mobs only! So if you wanna trap a crowd for a while, this is a good choice (you can also craft it using Azure and Scarlet Neodymium ingots from Alex's Caves)

**Super Surprise:** what is so super about it? It combusts into flames after a while, setting anyone around it ablaze!

**Party Horn:** cannot be crafted, but can be obtained from Partyger. Just like Partyger does it, blast everybody away!
</details>

_Structures:_
<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

![Imprecator's Hut](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/BiEgQKpJ/images/0d697e5cb8391f9085df60f0e6ed3782af479dcf.png)

**Imprecator's Hut:** In dark oak forests, you may encounter Imprecator's hut, which has trapped allays and has other illagers besides Imprecator, there's also a secret treasure in the closed top of the hut

---------------

![Illagers Fortress House](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/BiEgQKpJ/images/32a8f44ee08bb2762272904f658d400e8339a6fb.png)

**Illagers Fortress House:** Illagers Fortress House is a guarded house, found in old growth taiga, that has various utilities and loot inside of it, and many illagers too...

---------------

![Withermancer's Shack](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/BiEgQKpJ/images/0bd259f7ac5a261ded357e80e2bf25b9cc913423.png)

**Withermancer's Shack:** Withermancer's Shack is a settlement found in savannas or dark oak forests, in which Withermancer and 2 other illagers reside in, the main interest is the wither skeleton skull found on a second floor

---------------

![Partyger's Cabin](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/BiEgQKpJ/images/10d54c9b03d45052e60e6429f62c69d132d5bb81.png)

**Partyger's Cabin:** Partyger's Cabin is a small cabin found in meadows or flower forest, in which Partyger lives in, nothing much can be said, but you can find a lot of chests and a few animals there
</details>

---------------

**Credit**

<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

- Chinese localization by luochenlinyu
- German localization by Sweegy
- Russian localization by me
</details>

**Additional Info**
- This mod will have possible updates in the future
- You can use this mod in your modpack/video
- Made using MCreator (a bit of custom code was used to make the illagers work properly)
- Fabric ports or backports are not planned
