better-combat.title: Better Combat
better-combat.description: ⚔️ Easy, spectacular and fun melee combat system from Minecraft Dungeons.
better-combat.body:
![Better Combat](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/5sy6g3kz/images/6d65cbe745229c36b7b97cb608926374724d8174.png)


# Easy, spectacular and fun melee combat system from Minecraft Dungeons.

‌
[![Modloader](https://img.shields.io/badge/Loader-Fabric%20|%20Forge-ecebe6?labelColor=263768&style=for-the-badge)](https://fabricmc.net)
[![Discord](https://img.shields.io/discord/973561601519149057.svg?label=&logo=discord&logoColor=ffffff&color=7389D8&labelColor=6A7EC2&style=for-the-badge)](https://discord.gg/KN9b3pjFTM)

### ✨ Looking for vanilla-friendly content? Try these!

[![Archers](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/XIpMGI6r/images/cd19a95a79f1157b33f31818aa615a280b206912.png "Archers")](https://modrinth.com/mod/archers "")[![Paladins](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/XIpMGI6r/images/3f19359bfd7521ba17bec818f125e87e09ef277e.png "Paladins")](https://modrinth.com/mod/paladins-and-priests "")[![Wizards](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/XIpMGI6r/images/a7da965aa108daf95c10448c01423be49ce2338d.png "Wizards")](https://modrinth.com/mod/wizards "")
[![Rogues](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/XIpMGI6r/images/278d8c941af6dc763cf714b9f36f8b8366a60eb9.png "Rogues")](https://modrinth.com/mod/rogues-and-warriors "")
[![Jewelry](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/XIpMGI6r/images/747102d582732b8defa50a2c925c7d5a6f87d009.png "Jewelry")](https://modrinth.com/mod/jewelry "")
[![Arsenal](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/XIpMGI6r/images/59a1006dfd980ddb35b96cfd86d7c367dcde2a2b.png)](https://modrinth.com/mod/arsenal-rpg-series "Arsenal")

# 🗡 Features

![slash](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/5sy6g3kz/images/38efa008bc297aa49572761bed1eff2399a1b2dc.gif "")
![stab](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/5sy6g3kz/images/d05e3c914008be42cb89db190ae73f767ca97873.gif "")
![slam](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/5sy6g3kz/images/89422bcaa8fcc18a05834da0b1027b07751e9722.gif "")

### Fancy attack animations
This mod includes several one-handed, two-handed and dual wielded attack animation resources.
### Accurate weapon collision detection
No more pixel hunting with your cursor, you can now just swing your weapon and hit whatever is in the way. Enjoy playing in third person view. :)
### Natural look and feel
Attacks have an upswing phase before the hit is actually performed, like in real life.
### Weapon combos
Some weapons have a sequence of different attacks.
### Dual wielding
Dual wield any one handed weapons! Use the attack hotkey to alternately attack with main-hand and off-hand.
### Reworked Sweeping Edge
Weapon swing hitting multiple enemies deal reduced damage. To deal full weapon damage against all targets, you need to have Sweeping Edge enchantment.
### Hold to attack
Hold the attack hotkey to spam attacks on cooldown (configurable).
### Swing thru grass
Attack instead of mining zero hardness blocks (configurable).
### Support any item from any mod (with data files)
Automatic compatibility with most mods (weapons without attribute file, will be automatically assigned a matching weapon preset, based on item id).

Super easy to add dedicated compatibility, support via Discord for partnering modders.

‌

‌

# 🔨 Add compatibility to any weapon
‌

Add uniquely created or out of the box behaviour to any weapon from any mod, by just creating **JSON** data files.

Check out our integration guide [here](https://github.com/ZsoltMolnarrr/BetterCombat#-integrate-your-mod "integration guide").

‌

# 🔧 Configuration
‌

**Client side** settings can be accessed via the [Mod Menu](https://github.com/TerraformersMC/ModMenu).

**Server side** config can be found at:

- General properties: `config/bettercombat/server.conf`

- Fallback compatibility: `config/bettercombat/fallback_config.conf`

Automatically created with default values, upon loading any game world for the first time. 

‌

# ⛓ Compatibility

‌

With an open source and modular mindset, this project is aiming for maximal compatibility. However, mods trying to change the same mechanics will never be compatible (such as dual wielding mods).

‌

## 🤝 Partnerships

‌

We partnered up with the following mods, to fully utilise the JSON API of Better Combat:

- [MC Dungeons Weapons](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/mcdw)

- [MCDoom](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/mcdoom)

- [MedievalWeapons](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/medievalweapons)

- [Mythic Metals](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/mythicmetals)

- [Simply Swords](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/simply-swords)

- [Spectrum](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/spectrum)

small-ships.body: # Small Ships *Medieval-inspired ships for exploration, trade, and naval battles!* --- ## Play with Friends! Want to play together with your friends? Check out **DatHost** for the best performance and easy setup! ### How to Get Started 1. Go to [**DatHost using my Link**](https://dathost.net/r/talhanation/minecraft-server-hosting) 2. Register your account. 3. Once registered, choose the plan that fits your needs 4. The **30% discount will be applied automatically** at checkout. **Important:** The discount only works if you order your server using this [** my Link**](https://dathost.net/r/talhanation/minecraft-server-hosting) ! [![DatHost](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/d6ec0353-37bd-4f09-a427-694da9f8c500)](https://dathost.net/minecraft-server-hosting?ref=talhanation) --- ## Showcase ## My Other Mods ### [**Villager Recruits**](https://modrinth.com/mod/villager-recruits): Command your own **Villager Army** into war! Now with **Diplomacy and Factions**! --- ### [**Villager Workers**](https://modrinth.com/mod/villager-workers): Hire Villagers and let them **work for you**! --- ### [![siegeweapons-icon](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/0e78b9e3-0d34-47a4-802e-adf55eec21e3)](https://modrinth.com/mod/siegeweapons) [**Siege Weapons**](https://modrinth.com/mod/siegeweapons): Prepare for war. Build your siege weapon. **Dominate the battlefield!** --- ## Explanation - Craft a Dockyard and place it next to water. - Right-click the Dockyard, choose a ship and a wood type and press "Build ship". The materials are taken from your inventory. - The finished ship is placed in the water near the Dockyard. The water has to be wide and deep enough. - Right-click the ship to board. The first player gets the helm. Other players get the free seat closest to where they clicked. - Press **R** to open/close the sail. - **W / S** to increase or decrease the sail. - **A / D** to steer. - The keys for your seat are shown on screen when you board. - Ships can only be built at the Dockyard. There are no crafting recipes for ships. - Ships can be lost. A sunken ship can not be recovered. --- ## Controls **Helm** | Key | Action | |---|---| | R | Open / close the sail | | W / S | More / less sail (4 steps). With closed sail: move slowly forward / backward | | A / D | Steer | | W | Row (Galley and Drakkar) | | Hold right mouse button | Aim the cannons on the side you are looking at | | Right mouse button + mouse wheel | Change ammo | | Space | Shoot | | E (inventory key) | Open ship inventory | | Mouse wheel | Camera distance in third person | **Gunner** | Key | Action | |---|---| | Hold right mouse button | Aim your cannon | | Right mouse button + mouse wheel | Change ammo | | Space | Shoot your cannon | **Other** - Right-click another spot of the ship with an empty hand to change your seat. - Right-click a cannon to sit at it as gunner. - Crouch + right-click to open the inventory from outside of the ship. - Right-click a mob while sitting in the ship to take it on board. - Right-click a mob on the ship to dismount it. - The sail key can be changed in the options. The other keys use your vanilla key binds. --- ## Dockyard - Materials are taken from your inventory. - Every job takes time. In creative mode it is free and instant. - Nobody can board a ship while the Dockyard works on it. ### Build - Choose the ship and one of the 9 wood types. - Any planks can be used. The wood type only changes the look of the ship. - The Dockyard shows the attributes and the wind profile of the ship before you build it. - Bigger ships need deeper water. The Dockyard tells you if the water is too shallow or if there is not enough room. | Ship | Planks | White Wool | String | Iron | Build time | |---|---|---|---|---|---| | Galley | 96 | 24 | 12 | 18 nuggets | 2:00 min | | Drakkar | 96 | 24 | 12 | 36 nuggets | 2:00 min | | Dhow | 96 | 48 | 48 | none | 2:00 min | | Caravel | 120 | 48 | 24 | 30 nuggets | 2:15 min | | Cog | 192 | 24 | 12 | 48 nuggets | 3:00 min | | Brigg | 240 | 48 | 24 | 8 ingots | 3:30 min | | Galleon | 336 | 72 | 36 | 12 ingots | 4:30 min | ### Modify Works on a ship within 16 blocks of the Dockyard. - Install or remove upgrades. - Mount or remove cannons. - Hang shields on the Drakkar. - Change sail color, mast banner and sail banner. - Rename the ship. - Repair hull and sails. Removed cannons, shields and banners are given back. Removed upgrades give back 30% of the material. --- ## Ships These are the default values. All of them can be changed in the config. | Ship | Hull | Speed | Turning | Slots | Cannons | Seats | Water | |---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---| | Cog | 400 HP | 27 km/h | 4.0 | 108 | 4 | 11 | cold | | Brigg | 500 HP | 30 km/h | 3.0 | 162 | 6 | 17 | cold | | Galley | 200 HP | 35 km/h | 5.0 | 54 | 2 | 12 | warm | | Drakkar | 200 HP | 28 km/h | 5.0 | 54 | 0 | 15 | cold | | Caravel | 250 HP | 32 km/h | 4.75 | 81 | 4 | 10 | any | | Dhow | 200 HP | 32 km/h | 4.5 | 135 | 4 | 12 | warm | | Galleon | 700 HP | 25 km/h | 1.5 | 216 | 10 | 34 | any | A mounted cannon can take up one seat. ### Cog - Trade ship with one mast (cold water). - Up to 4 cannons, 2 on each side. - Best with tail wind. ### Brigg - Trade ship with two masts (cold water). - Up to 6 cannons, 3 on each side. - Best with tail wind. ### Galley - Warship with one sail and oars (warm water). - Up to 2 cannons, 1 on each side. - With oars it reaches 85% of its speed in any wind. - Takes no hull damage when it rams another ship. - Best with side wind. ### Drakkar - Viking ship with one sail and oars (cold water). - With oars it reaches 75% of its speed in any wind. - Up to 10 shields, 5 on each side. Each shield reduces the damage to the ship by 3%. - Breaks ice. - Best with tail wind. ### Caravel - Ship with two masts. - Up to 4 cannons, 2 on each side. - Can sail against the wind. Best with head wind and side wind. - Same speed in every biome. ### Dhow - Trade ship with two masts (warm water). - Up to 4 cannons, 2 on each side. - Cargo does not slow it down. - Best with side wind. ### Galleon - The biggest ship, with three masts. - Up to 10 cannons, 5 on each side. - Cannons do not slow it down. - Same speed in every biome. - Best with tail wind. --- ## Detailed Features ### Wind - The wind changes direction and strength every few minutes. It is stronger in rain and thunder. - White lines on the water show the wind direction while you are on a ship. The banner on the mast shows it too. - Every ship has its own wind profile. The table shows the speed change at full wind strength with full sail. - A ship can not get faster than its max speed. - Oars are not affected by the wind. - The sail closes when nobody is at the helm. | Ship | Head wind | Side wind | Tail wind | |---|---|---|---| | Cog | -70% | +10% | +50% | | Brigg | -75% | +20% | +40% | | Galley | -30% | +40% | 0% | | Drakkar | -70% | +10% | +40% | | Caravel | +10% | +15% | -20% | | Dhow | -40% | +20% | 0% | | Galleon | -100% | -20% | +50% | ### Ship Performance - **Cold-water ships** → 20% faster in cold biomes, 20% slower in warm. - **Warm-water ships** → 20% faster in warm biomes, 20% slower in cold. - Both are 5% slower in biomes that are neither cold nor warm. - Each cannon decreases speed by **2.5%** (not on the Galleon). - Cargo can decrease speed by up to **10%** (not on the Dhow). - Torn sails give 25% less speed. Destroyed sails give no speed. ### Cannons - Cannons are mounted at the Dockyard. Each cannon needs one Ship Cannon item. - Remove a cannon at the Dockyard or in the ship inventory (click and hold). - At the helm you aim and shoot all cannons on the side you are looking at. - A gunner aims and shoots only his own cannon. The helm does not shoot cannons that have a gunner. - While aiming, the camera is on the barrel and a line shows where the shot goes. - Ammo is taken from the ship inventory first, then from the inventory of the shooter. - The HUD shows the available ammo while aiming. - Reloading takes about 4 seconds. - A hit on the mast damages the sails. A hit on the hull damages the hull. - Hits on a ship throw wood debris and sail shreds. - Cannonballs that hit the ground make a small explosion. - Passengers can not damage their own ship. ### Ammo - **Cannon Ball** → normal shot, best against the hull. - **Chained Shot** → 25% less range and damage, heavy damage to sails. - **Grape Shot** → short range, best against the crew. - **Fine-Grain Powder** → used up when shooting, +50% range. ### Ground Cannon - Use the Ship Cannon item on the ground to place it. - Right-click to use it. **W / S** to move, **A / D** to turn. - Hold the right mouse button to aim. Double right-click turns the barrel back to the front. - Shoot with **Space**. Ammo is taken from your inventory. ### Ramming - Ships damage each other when they collide at 20 km/h or more. - More speed means more damage. The smaller ship takes more damage and gets pushed away. - The crew of both ships takes damage too. - Hitting land at high speed damages your own ship. - A sailing ship pushes and damages mobs in its way. ### Sinking - Ships do not repair themselves. - A ship with no hull HP left sinks with a sinking animation. The crew is thrown into the water. - **A sunken ship is lost.** It can not be repaired, boarded or picked up. - The wreck despawns after 15 minutes and drops its cargo and cannons. ### Ship Repairing - Hull: right-click with an iron nugget while you have planks in your inventory. Works up to 66% hull. - Sail patching: right-click with string while you have an iron nugget in your inventory. Works up to 33% sail. - Dockyard: repairs hull and sails completely. Costs 4 planks and 1 iron nugget per 10 hull HP and 1 wool per 5 sail HP. ### Ship Upgrades - **Iron Scantlings** → +100% hull HP. - **Copper Plating** → +20% turning. - **Cotton Sails** → +10% speed. - Upgrades are installed at the Dockyard. Bigger ships need more items: | Ship | Iron Scantlings | Copper Plating | Cotton Sails | |---|---|---|---| | Cog | 4 | 4 | 1 | | Brigg | 12 | 8 | 4 | | Galley | 5 | 4 | 1 | | Drakkar | 5 | 5 | 1 | | Caravel | 5 | 4 | 2 | | Dhow | 3 | 3 | 2 | | Galleon | 16 | 12 | 8 | ### Inventory - Hoppers can put items into the ship inventory and take them out. - The ship inventory shows speed and damage of the ship. - Cannons, banners and shields can be removed in the ship inventory (click and hold). ### Sail Coloring - Right-click with dye to color sails. ### Banners - Right-click with a banner to put it on the mast. Shears remove it. - A banner pattern can be put on the sail at the Dockyard. ### Shields - Right-click the Drakkar with a shield to hang it up. An axe removes it. - Shields with banner patterns are supported. - Epic Knights shields are supported. ### Ship Naming - Use a nametag to name your ship, or rename it at the Dockyard. ### Leashing - Right-click a ship with a lead to pull it. - Right-click a fence to tie the ship to it. - A leashed ship can not sail. ### Other - Decks are walkable. - Mobs can be passengers. NPCs standing on the deck leave onto nearby land when the ship lies still. - All ships break lily pads. - Bubble columns do not affect ships. - Water animals swim away from ships. - Vanilla boats are 75% slower by default. --- ## Crafting **Dockyard** **Ship Cannon** (any log) **Cannon Ball** Gunpowder in the middle, 4 iron nuggets on the sides. Gives 2. **Chained Shot** Chain in the middle, 4 Cannon Balls in the corners. Gives 2. **Grape Shot** Gunpowder in the middle, 8 iron nuggets around it. **Fine-Grain Powder** **Iron Scantlings** **Copper Plating** **Cotton Sails** --- ## Config **Server config** (`smallships-server.toml`, in the `serverconfig` folder of the world). Server values are synced to the clients. - Attributes for each ship: hull HP, speed, turning, acceleration, inventory size, water type. Changes apply to existing ships. - `dockyardBuildableShips`: ships that can be built at the Dockyard. Empty = all ships. - Upgrades: enable, cost, time, refund and strength. - Wind: enable, change interval, minimum strength in rain and thunder. - Cannon damage, block destruction, sail damage, collision damage, shield damage reduction. - Speed modifiers for cargo, cannons and biomes. - `mountBlackList`: entities that can not mount a ship. - `driverEntities`: non-player entities that can take the helm (default: `recruits:captain`). - Vanilla boat speed, despawn time of sunken ships, `updateCheckerEnable`. **Client config** (`smallships-client.toml`, in the `config` folder) - Speed unit: km/h, m/s, knots or mph. - Camera: auto third person, camera centered on the ship, zoom distance. - Wind particles and banner movement. - Creative tab, `updateCheckerEnable`. **Commands** - `/smallships wind` shows the wind direction and strength. - `/smallships wind setDirection <0-360>` sets the wind direction (north = 0, clockwise). Needs OP. - `/smallships wind setStrength <0-1>` sets the wind strength. Needs OP. **Update checker** - Shows a chat message with a download link when a new version is available. --- ## Datapacks and Addons Dockyard recipes can be changed with a datapack. One file per ship: `data//dockyard_recipes/.json`. `build_time` is in ticks. ```json { "build_time": 3600, "ingredients": [ { "tag": "minecraft:planks", "count": 192 }, { "item": "minecraft:white_wool", "count": 24 }, { "item": "minecraft:string", "count": 12 }, { "item": "minecraft:iron_nugget", "count": 48 } ] } ``` Addon mods can add their own ships with the ship registry. Registered ships show up in the Dockyard. ```java ShipRegistry.register(ShipType.builder(new ResourceLocation("myaddon", "longship"), LongshipEntity::summon) .buildTime(110 * 20) .ingredient(ItemTags.PLANKS, 112) .ingredient(Items.WHITE_WOOL, 20) .build()); ``` The Fabric version needs Fabric API. --- ## Modpack Permissions You are allowed to use the Small Ships Mod in any modpack, as long as you link back to this page and don’t make money off of it. ---

the-graveyard.title: The Graveyard
the-graveyard.description: Upon death, you will find yourself in the Graveyard Dimension.
the-graveyard.body:
# **STILL IN BETA**
### Please report any bugs to this discord: https://discord.gg/CW5CA6t6Zu

## 🪦 **The Graveyard**
Upon death, you will find yourself in the Graveyard. 

The Graveyard is a dimension where dead people lie forever, or until they find a way out.

![Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/87cd62c7cd36c71c4888a72a28c275249ef55e95_0.webp)
## 👻 The dimension
The Graveyard is a mirror dimension of the Overworld. It has the same terrain, but it is only a Pale Garden biome.

![Overworld -> Graveyard comparison](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/510700224d65660d39156a17815c6d41199dc1d7.gif)

When you die, you will fall from the sky of the Graveyard, over the spawn coordinates.

In the Graveyard, you are very weak, but immortal. You are unable to sprint and destroying blocks is a tedious task.

When looking around, you might see the people of the Overworld wandering, and they will also be able to see your ghost in the Overworld. These ghosts are live representations of players, meaning that you can interact between dimensions.

Some of the hostile mobs from the Graveyard have special ablities that they do not have anywhere else.

Shields break upon use in the Graveyard.

## 🕯️ The soul
Even if you are immortal, you still have something to worry about: **your soul**. 

Your soul acts as your health bar, where it depeats when getting hit by mobs or simply by taking damage from most damage sources. It is displayed in your chest slot.

You can heal your soul by crouching while holding the remains of the mobs you killed. This will use up the items.

<details>
<summary>List of consumables</summary>

- Rotten Flesh
- Bone
- Spider Eye
- Gunpowder
- Slime Ball
- Ender Pearl
- Creaking Heart
- Ink Sac
- Glow Ink Sac

</details>

Your soul has 200 energy, but it starts at 50. There are buffs scaled based on how much energy you have, but when at 0, you get major debuffs.

You can check how much energy you have by hovering over your soul located in the chest slot.

## 🧟 Revival
There are three ways to get out of the Graveyard.

The people from the Overworld can craft a Recovery Core and drop it at a ghost's feet to recover them, but this is not a full revival. They will come back at a capped 5 hearts.

Players stuck in the Graveyard can still get out by themselves. They will need to craft a Reawakening Apple and when the soul is at 200 energy, the player can consume the apple to go back to the Overworld at a capped 3 hearts.

To fully save someone from the Graveyard, a player from the Overworld will need to upgrade a Recovery Core to a Resurrection Crystal. This item can be dropped to a ghost's feet or to a recovered/reawakened player to fully resurrect them.

**See crafting recipes in Gallery Tab**

## Info
Keep Inventory is always off to prevent players from smuggling items in the Graveyard.

Operators can run the command _/function graveyard:give_items_ to obtain the Recovery Core, the Resurrection Crystal and the Reawakening Apple.

<details>
<summary>Installation</summary>
  
### Server Installation (Datapack)
  
1. Go in the main server file
  
2. Open _world_ -> _datapacks_

3. Upload the datapack in the _datapacks_ folder

### World Installation (Datapack)

1. Press Win + R and enter %appdata%

2. Open _.minecraft_ -> _saves_ -> _<world name>_ -> datapacks

3. Upload the datapack in the _datapacks_ folder

(Note that if you are using a launcher like Modrinth App or Prism Launcher, you'll need to go on your instance on the launcher and click on _Open Folder_.)

### Server Installation (Mod)

1. Go in the main server file

2. Open _mods_

3. Upload the mod in the _mods_ folder
</details>

adventurez.body:
![Headline](https://i.imgur.com/zuOfip3.png)
[](https://discord.gg/cV4cJyGXqF) [](https://globox1997.github.io/wiki/mods/AdventureZ/) [](https://github.com/Globox1997/AdventureZ/issues)


This mod adds a new end boss to Minecraft besides other deadly creatures. The boss is called "Blackstone Golem" and will be the hardest enemy you ever encountered. If you will start a war against the Piglins, watch out, they will call their Beast for help! And maybe you´ll even get caught by the Soul Reaper which usually findable in the soul sand valley. Almost forgot to mention: Somebody has seen a weird looking small creature crawling around... Enable another end boss fight by adding [VoidZ](https://modrinth.com/mod/voidz)

Creatures Blackstone Golem - Spawns with ritual Piglin Beast - Spawns randomly while attacking piglins and mining nether gold ore Soul Reaper (Mount: Nightmare) - Spawns in soul sand valley Necromancer - Spawns in nether fortress's Summoner (and its vanguard) - Spawns during thunderstorm Blaze Guardian - Spawns in nether fortress's Dragon You have to kill the Eye to reclaim the dragon egg. The egg will feel the Fame you reached by killing the Eye and will hatch over time (about 10mins). After the Dragon hatched, tame it by feeding it with raw meat or orc skin. The Dragon has to grow up one stage to be rideable (dragon saddle needed) and another stage to carry a chest.


Boss Summoning Stone Golem Spawning Get 4 Gilded Blackstone Shards by bartering with piglins or find them in the nether bastions. Build 4 Chiseled Polished Blackstone Holder by putting Chiseled Polished Blackstone into the stone cutter. Place a circular area of blackstone blocks (or whatever is similar to blackstone) with a radius of 5 and put one each edge the stone holder just like this: After you placed all 4 shards into their holder the ritual will start..... The Eye Spawning Built this altar and wait a little bit.


Items - Handbook ([Patchouli](https://modrinth.com/mod/patchouli) mod necessary) - Blackstone Golem drops: Blackstone Heart, Gilded Shard, Netherite, Blackstone - Soul Reaper drops: Wither Head, Coal - Piglin Beast drops: Gold Ingots, Piglin Flag - Necromancer drops: Enchanted Book - Summoner drops: Enchanted Book - Nightmare is tameable Piglin Flag The Piglin Flag has to charge itself and when it´s charged and you get close, all aggressive Piglins will get calm. Gilded Netherite Armor Stronger version of the netherite armor but piglins won´t attack you! (And a full set effect) Handbook
[](https://globox1997.github.io)

[](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api) [](https://modrinth.com/mod/cloth-config) This mod is developed for Fabric. There are no plans to develop a Forge version. Modpack Permission: Feel free to use it in any modpacks. Bug Report: Just report bugs at the github page. License: Sound effects are either licensed under [https://audiojungle.net/licenses/terms/audio_sfx_media_single](https://audiojungle.net/licenses/terms/audio_sfx_media_single) or modified sounds from vanilla Minecraft. For an in game wiki book, install [Patchouli](https://modrinth.com/mod/patchouli) mod and check the creative inventory for an AdventureZ handbook.

graveyard.title: The Graveyard - Resurrected
graveyard.description: Continuation of a popular mod called "The Graveyard"
graveyard.body:
![The Graveyard - Resurrected](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7b4193dc603d7b75a6f6a011bfa306094b98a4a7.png)

This mod is a continuation of the popular mod called "The Graveyard". The reason for the continuation was lack of updates from the original developer. This mod aims to maintain the amazing work that has been done for this mod so that people can continue to experience it in newer versions of Minecraft. I may add new content in the future. 

Here is the link to the original mod: [https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/the-graveyard-forge](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/the-graveyard-forge) and its github repository, where this version was forked from: [https://github.com/finallion/The-Graveyard-FORGE](https://github.com/finallion/The-Graveyard-FORGE)

Do not submit issues with this fork to the original repository. Instead, use the "Report issues" link on this page to go to the appropriate issue form.

Below is the **original description** of the mod (somewhat adjusted):

The Graveyard adds new spooky biomes, structures, mobs and blocks to make your minecraft adventure more thrilling and challenging.
Every structure, mob and biome was built with a lot of attention to detail to create an immersive experience for you.


<details>
<summary>Mod Trailers</summary>

<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/w_kHpDmcqDI" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/EEm1dy-2mKc" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/p7IH7JctKkE" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

</details>



<details>
<summary>Boss - Corrupted Champion (Lich)</summary>

The Corrupted Champion is the entombed remnant of an unknown hero, fallen into corruption. Its power arise from its bone staff, which was crafted from the bones of its innocent victims. With its power, the lich can controll the minds of its enemies and turn peaceful beings into abominations fighting along its side. But beware. Even if you manage to drain the staff's corruption, the fight isn't over.
 

### Music

The fight has an epic and chilling boss music done by Rotch Gwylt.
 

### Phases

Spell phase abilities: Bone Vortex Attack, Skull Cast Attack, Levitation Spell, Falling Corpses Spell, Summon Minions Spell, Labyrinth Heal Attack.
Hunt phase abilities: Darkness encases the player while the Lich hunts its prey. Don't let it come to close.
Deformation phase
 

### How to summon the Corrupted Champion

1. Collect the three bone staff pieces (Ominous Bone Staff Fragment) from the Ruins structure. Every Ruin has a unique fragment (upper, middle and lower bone staff fragment).
2. Obtain a bone dagger from an Acolyte, or craft it yourself.
3. Hold a glass bottle in your offhand and start killing villager with the bone dagger. 4. You'll get a Vial of Blood. Fill the vial to the limit.
5. Find the Lich Prison structure, a large floating island above the oceans.
6. Wait until it is night, place the bone staff pieces (from upper to lower) on the dark corrupted deepslate blocks in front of the altar (they should fairly stand out).
7. Pour the Vial of Blood into the altar.
8. Voilà, you unleashed pure evil into the world, probably causing the death of thousands of innocent people and very likely your own.

</details>


<details>
<summary>Structures</summary>

- Haunted House: uncover the secrets of this run down house.
- Small Grave: a final resting place encountered frequently while exploring.
- Small Graveyard: a cemetery that comes in multiple variants.
- Medium Graveyard: a quite large cemetery in the woods surrounding a minecraft temple. It holds a lot to explore and to gather, but nothing comes without a risk. Especially at night.
- Mushroom Grave: an overgrown grave, spawning in swamps, jungles and mushroom islands.
- Memorial Birch Tree: an imposing tree found in birch forests.
- Large Graveyard: an immense jigsaw structure generating in forests. But be warned - it is full of dangers.
- Crypt: an expansive labyrinth, full of traps, loot and dangers, hidden in the depths.
- Ruins: destroyed and ravaged places filled with the remains of their former inhabitants.
- Lich Prison: an isolated floating island above the oceans.
- Dead Tree: something horrible happened here in the past. A dead memorial to unknown cruelties.

</details>


<details>
<summary>Mobs</summary>

### Hostile Mobs

- Skeleton Creeper: a faster undead variant of the creeper. It may has lost his destructive powers, but its haunting appearance will blind you.
- Acolyte: a darker representative of the illager family. If he'll find you, your bones will serve him as a new weapon.
- Reaper: Ghosts? Here, in a spooky graveyard mod? No... The reaper takes this place.
Ghoul: a deformed revenant, hold together only by his rage on the living.
- Revenant: the animated remains of a once human being.
- Nightmare: a deformed creature that moves quicker than it seems. Better stay away and never look at it.
- Wraith: haunting those who dare to desecrate its coffin.
Corrupted Illager: a fast undead version of the illagers.
 

### Passive Mobs

- Ghouling: summoned by the bone staff, it will only follow its conjurer. Use the staff to command it! And giving it a coffin might help your inventory managment.
- Nameless Hanged: suffering in eternal pain, the nameless hanged offers rare artifacts.

</details>


<details>
<summary>Blocks and Items</summary>

- Corruption: ↸ᔑ∷ꖌ ᔑリ↸ ᒷ⍊╎ꖎ ᒲᔑℸ ̣ ℸ ̣ ᒷ∷
- Sarcophagus: a final resting place now turned into storage space.
- Coffin: a final wooden resting place in all wood variants.
- Glazed Urn: a beautiful ornated urn, that serves as storage.
- Small Urn: a simple urn, that serves as storage.
- Fire Brazier: a dark cryptic iron bowl, displaying soul flames or flames when ignited.
- Dark Iron Ingot: an ashen version of iron
- Dark Iron Block: decorative steel-like block
- Dark Iron Door/Trapdoor: dark version of the iron door and trapdoor, but no need for redstone to open them.
- Dark Iron Bars: like vanilla iron bars, but dark and matching the theme.
- Skeletons: a fragile decoration block in many different forms that can be found in graveyard structures.
- Gravestone: edit the gravestone to create a memorial for your lost minecraft dog or horse.
- Ceramics: vases to decorate the graveyards (not craftable).
- Bone Dagger: crafted with bones, this weapon is used in dark rituals. It may also be useful for breaking glass.
- Ominous Bone Staff Fragment: broken pieces of the bone staff, used to summoned the lich.
- Altar: the prison of the lich and the place to free it again.
- Ossuary: allows crafting of skeleton decorations from bone blocks.

</details>

bosses-of-mass-destruction.title: Bosses of Mass Destruction
bosses-of-mass-destruction.body:
## Are you looking to add some more exciting boss fights to your world?  The aim of this mod is to create epic endgame boss fights.

Right now, this mod has four bosses.

Night Lich, found in rare towers in cold biomes. Locate the towers by following soul stars.
Obsidilith, which appears in rare structures in the end islands.
Nether Gauntlet, which appears in rare structures in the nether. 
Void Blossom, appears in rare caves at the bottom of the world. Void lilies will point the way.
They can be accessed in creative via the /summon command.


## FAQ

**Can you port this mod to Forge or an older Minecraft version?**

-   I will not, but anyone else may do so.

## Installation:

Installed like any regular fabric mod with dependencies below.

-   [Geckolib 3](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/geckolib/files)
-   [Fabric Language Kotlin](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/fabric-language-kotlin)
-   [Fabric API](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/fabric-api)
-   [Cardinal Components](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/cardinal-components)
-   [Cloth Config](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/cloth-config)

[Dev Roadmap](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1FWIecLltFT8ySfeusy30RAh5R36tWVKUvW9p6qo66AU/edit?usp=sharing)
